ar.clean: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: كنا نتحدث عن حجة الوداع، والنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بين أظهرنا، ولا ندري ما حجة الوداع، حتى حمد الله رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، وأثنى عليه، ثم ذكر المسيح الدجال فأطنب في ذكره، وقال: “ ما بعث الله من نبي إلا أنذره أمته: أنذره نوح والنبيون من بعده، وإنه إن يخرج فيكم فما خفي عليكم من شأنه فليس يخفى عليكم، إن ربكم ليس بأعور، وإنه أعور عين اليمنى، كأن عينه عنبة طافية. ألا إن الله حرم عليكم دماءكم وأموالكم ، كحرمة يومكم هذا، في بلدكم هذا، في شهركم هذا، ألا هل بلغت؟” قالوا: نعم، قال: “اللهم اشهد -ثلاثًا- ويلكم، أو ويحكم، انظروا، لا ترجعوا بعدي كفارًا يضرب بعضكم رقاب بعض"

Allah’a hamd edip senâda bulundu; sonra Mesîh Deccâl’i uzun uzun anlattı ve şöyle buyurdu: ‘Allah’ın gönderdiği hiçbir peygamber yoktur ki ümmetini ona karşı uyarmış olmasın. Nûh da ondan sonraki peygamberler de uyardı. O aranızda çıkarsa, onun hâlinden size gizli kalan şey olsa bile şu size gizli kalmaz: Rabbiniz tek gözlü değildir; o ise sağ gözü kördür, gözü sanki dışarı fırlamış üzüm tanesi gibidir. Biliniz ki Allah kanlarınızı ve mallarınızı, şu gününüzün, şu beldenizde ve şu ayınızda haramlığı gibi size haram kılmıştır. Tebliğ ettim mi?’ Dediler ki: ‘Evet.’ Üç defa: ‘Allah’ım, şahit ol’ buyurdu. Sonra: ‘Yazık size yahut dikkat edin; benden sonra birbirinizin boynunu vuran kâfirler hâline dönmeyin’ dedi.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Ibn Umar (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: We used to speak about the Farewell Pilgrimage while the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) was among us, though we did not know what the Farewell Pilgrimage meant. Then the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) praised Allah and extolled Him, mentioned the False Messiah at length, and said: ‘Allah never sent a prophet except that he warned his community against him. Noah warned against him, and so did the prophets after him. If he emerges among you, even if some aspect of him is unclear to you, this will not be unclear: your Lord is not one-eyed, whereas he is blind in his right eye; his eye is like a protruding grape. Indeed Allah has made your blood and your property sacred to you, like the sanctity of this day of yours, in this land of yours, in this month of yours. Have I conveyed?’ They said: ‘Yes.’ He said three times: ‘O Allah, bear witness.’ Then he said: ‘Woe to you—or beware—do not revert after me to disbelief, striking one another’s necks.’

en.clean: Abu Kabshah 'Amr bin Sa'd (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "I swear by Allah for three (qualities) which I am going to tell you about. Remember them well:(1) The wealth of a man will not diminish by Sadaqah (charity).(2) Allah augments the honour of a man who endures an oppression patiently.(3) He who opens a gate of begging, Allah opens a gate of poverty (or he said a word similar to it)."He (ﷺ) also said, "Remember well what I am going to tell you: The world is for four kinds of people. (1) One upon whom Allah has bestowed wealth and knowledge and so he fears his Rubb in respect to them, joins the ties of blood relationship and acknowledges the Rights of Allah on him (and fulfills them); this type will have the best position (in Jannah). (2) One upon whom Allah has conferred knowledge but no wealth, and he is sincere in his intention and says: 'Had I possessed wealth, I would have acted like so-and-so.' If that is his intention, his reward is the same as that of the other. (3) One whom Allah has given wealth but no knowledge and he squanders his wealth ignorantly, does not fear Allah in respect to it, does not discharge the obligations of kinship and does not acknowledge the Rights of Allah. Such a person will be in the worst position (in the Hereafter). (4) One upon whom Allah has bestowed neither wealth nor knowledge and he says: 'Had I possessed wealth, I would have acted like so-and-so (i.e., he would squander his wealth).' If this is his intention, both will have equal sin.".

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Ebû Kebşe Amr b. Sa'd el-Enmârî radıyallahu anh'den rivayet edildiğine göre, Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem'i şöyle buyururken işitti: “Üç şey vardır ki onların üzerine yemin ederim; size bir söz de anlatacağım, onu iyi belleyin: Bir kulun malı sadaka sebebiyle eksilmez. Bir kul haksızlığa uğrar da ona sabrederse Allah onun izzetini mutlaka artırır. Bir kul dilenme kapısını açarsa Allah da ona fakirlik kapısını açar; yahut buna benzer bir söz buyurdu. Size bir söz anlatacağım, onu iyi belleyin: Dünya ancak dört kişi içindir: Allah'ın kendisine mal ve ilim verdiği kul; o, bu malda Rabbinden sakınır, onunla akrabalık bağını gözetir ve onda Allah'ın hakkı bulunduğunu bilir. İşte bu, en üstün derecededir. Allah'ın kendisine ilim verdiği, fakat mal vermediği kul; niyeti doğrudur ve ‘Benim de malım olsaydı falanın yaptığı gibi yapardım’ der. O niyetine göredir; ikisinin ecri eşittir. Allah'ın kendisine mal verdiği, fakat ilim vermediği kul; o, malında bilgisizce bocalar, onda Rabbinden sakınmaz, onunla akrabalık bağını gözetmez ve onda Allah'ın hakkı bulunduğunu bilmez. rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: It is narrated from Abu Kabshah 'Amr ibn Sa'd al-Anmari, may Allah be pleased with him, that he heard the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, say: “There are three matters about which I swear, and I will tell you a statement, so preserve it: A servant's wealth is not diminished by charity; no servant is wronged and patiently bears that wrong except that Allah increases him in honor; and no servant opens a door of asking except that Allah opens for him a door of poverty,” or words similar to that. “And I will tell you a statement, so preserve it. The world is for four kinds of people: a servant to whom Allah has given wealth and knowledge, and he fears his Lord concerning it, maintains kinship through it, and knows that Allah has a right in it; this one is in the best station. A servant to whom Allah has given knowledge but not wealth, and he is truthful in intention, saying, ‘If I had wealth, I would act as so-and-so acts’; he is according to his intention, and the reward of the two is equal. A servant to whom Allah has given wealth but not knowledge, and he flounders with his wealth without knowledge, does not fear his Lord concerning it, does not maintain kinship through it, and does not know that Allah has a right in it; this one is in the worst station. And a servant to whom Allah has given neither wealth nor knowledge, and he says, ‘If I had wealth, I would act in it as so-and-so acts’; he is according to his intention, and the burden of sin of the two is equal.”
rawExcel.sunnah.com_arabic_full_text: وعن أبي كبشة عمرو بن سعد الأنمارى رضي الله عنه أنه سمع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: "ثلاثة أقسم عليهن وأحدثكم حديثاً فاحفظوه: ما نقص مال عبد من صدقة،ولا ظلم عبد مظلمة صبر عليها إلا زاده الله عزاً، ولا فتح عبد باب مسألة إلا فتح الله عليه باب فقر، أو كلمة نحوها وأحدثكم حديثاً فاحفظوه قال: إنما الدنيا لأربعة نفر: عبد رزقه الله مالاً وعلماً، فهو يتقى فيه ربه، ويصل فيه رحمه، ويعلم لله فيه حقاً فهذا بأفضل المنازل. وعبد رزقه الله علماً، ولم يرزقه مالاً فهو صادق النية يقول: لو أن لى مالاً لعملت بعمل فلان، فهو بنيته فأجرهما سواء. وعبد رزقه الله مالاً، ولم يرزقه علماً، فهو يخبط فى ماله بغير علم، لا يتقى فيه ربه ولا يصل فيه رحمه، ولا يعلم لله فيه حقاً، فهذا بأخبث المنازل. وعبد لم يرزقه الله مالاً ولا علماً، فهو يقول: لو أن لى مالاً لعملت فيه بعمل فلان، فهو بنيته، فوزرهما سواء”

en.clean: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "While a man was walking through a barren land, he heard a voice coming out of a cloud saying: 'Irrigate the garden of so-and- so.' Thereupon the cloud drifted in a certain direction and discharged its water over a rocky plain. The streamlets flowed into a channel. This man followed the channel until it reached a garden and he saw the owner of the garden standing in its center, working with his spade spreading the water (changing the course of the water). He asked him: "O slave of Allah, what is your name?" He told his name, which was the same that he heard from the cloud. The owner of the garden then asked him: "O slave of Allah, why did you ask my name?" He replied: "I heard a voice from a cloud which poured down this water saying: 'Irrigate the garden of so-and-so.' I would like to know what do you do with it." He said: "Now that you asked me, I will tell you. I estimate the produce of the garden and distribute one-third of it in charity, I spend one-third on myself and my family and invest one-third back into the garden.".

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Yine Ebû Hüreyre radıyallahu anh'den, Peygamber sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem'den rivayet edildiğine göre şöyle buyurdu: “Bir adam yeryüzünde ıssız bir yerde yürürken bir bulutun içinde ‘Falanın bahçesini sula’ diye bir ses işitti. Bulut bir tarafa yönelip suyunu taşlık siyah bir araziye boşalttı. Derken oradaki su yollarından biri bütün suyu içine aldı. Adam suyu takip etti; bir de baktı ki bir kişi bahçesinde ayakta, suyu küreğiyle yönlendiriyor. Ona: ‘Ey Allah'ın kulu! Adın nedir?’ dedi. Adam, bulutta işittiği adı söyledi. Bahçe sahibi: ‘Ey Allah'ın kulu! Adımı niçin soruyorsun?’ dedi. O da: ‘Bu suyu taşıyan bulutta bir ses işittim; senin adını söyleyerek “Falanın bahçesini sula” diyordu. Sen bu bahçede ne yapıyorsun?’ dedi. Bahçe sahibi: ‘Madem bunu söyledin, ben buradan çıkan ürüne bakarım; üçte birini sadaka veririm, üçte birini kendim ve ailem yeriz, üçte birini de tekrar bahçeye döndürürüm’ dedi.” ‘Harre’, siyah taşlarla kaplı arazi demektir. ‘Şerce’; şın harfi üstün, râ sakin ve cîm ile okunur; suyun aktığı yer demektir.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: It is narrated from him, from the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, that he said: “While a man was walking in an open, barren land, he heard a voice in a cloud saying: ‘Water the garden of so-and-so.’ That cloud moved aside and poured its water upon a black stony tract. One of the water channels absorbed all that water. He followed the water and found a man standing in his garden, directing the water with his spade. He said to him: ‘O servant of Allah, what is your name?’ He gave the name that he had heard in the cloud. The man said to him: ‘O servant of Allah, why do you ask me about my name?’ He said: ‘I heard a voice in the cloud whose water this is, saying: Water the garden of so-and-so, mentioning your name. What do you do with it?’ He said: ‘Since you have said this, I look at what comes from it: I give one third in charity, I and my family eat one third, and I return one third to it.’” “Al-ḥarrah” is land covered with black stones. “Al-sharjah,” with fatḥah on the shin, sukun on the ra', and jim, is a watercourse.

items.text_ar: وعنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: “بينما رجل يمشى بفلاة من الأرض، فسمع صوتاً فى سحابة: إسق حديقة فلان، فتنحى ذلك السحاب فأفرغ ماءه فى حرة، فإذا شرجة من تلك الشراح قد استوعبت ذلك الماء كله، فتتبع الماء، فإذا رجل قائم فى حديقته يحول الماء بمسحاته، فقال له: يا عبد الله ما اسمك ، قال: فلان للاسم الذى سمع فى السحابة، فقال له: يا عبد الله لم تسألني عن اسمي ؟ فقال: إنى سمعت صوتاً فى السحاب الذى هذا ماؤه يقول: اسق حديقة فلان لإسمك، فما تصنع فيها؟ فقال: أما إذا قلت هذا فإنى أنظر إلى ما يخرج منها، فأتصدق بثلثه، وآكل أنا وعيالى ثلثاً، وأرد فيها ثلثه “الحرة” الأرض الملبسة حجارة سوداء. “والشرجة” بفتح الشين المعجمة وإسكان الراء وبالجيم: هى مسيل الماء.
items.text_tr: Hz. Ebû Bekir’in kızı Esmâ (ra) anlatıyor: Resûlullah bana şöyle söyledi: –Kesenin ağzını bağlama, senin rızkın da bağlanır. Bir başka rivayette: –Malını infak et, sayarak verme; yoksa Allah da sana kıt verir. Malını tutup cimrilik etme; Allah da senin rızkını kapatır.
items.text_en: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "While a man was walking through a barren land, he heard a voice coming out of a cloud saying: 'Irrigate the garden of so-and- so.' Thereupon the cloud drifted in a certain direction and discharged its water over a rocky plain. The streamlets flowed into a channel. This man followed the channel until it reached a garden and he saw the owner of the garden standing in its center, working with his spade spreading the water (changing the course of the water). He asked him: "O slave of Allah, what is your name?" He told his name, which was the same that he heard from the cloud. The owner of the garden then asked him: "O slave of Allah, why did you ask my name?" He replied: "I heard a voice from a cloud which poured down this water saying: 'Irrigate the garden of so-and-so.' I would like to know what do you do with it." He said: "Now that you asked me, I will tell you. I estimate the produce of the garden and distribute one-third of it in charity, I spend one-third on myself and my family and invest one-third back into the garden.".

en.clean: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who recites after every prayer: Subhan-Allah (Allah is free from imperfection) thirty-three times; Al-hamdu lillah (praise be to Allah) thirty-three times; Allahu Akbar (Allah is Greatest) thirty-three times; and completes the hundred with: La ilaha illallahu, wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa Huwa 'ala kulli shai'in Qadir (there is no true god except Allah. He is One and He has no partner with Him. His is the sovereignty and His is the praise, and He is Omnipotent), will have all his sins pardoned even if they may be as large as the foam on the surface of the sea.".

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Fâtıma bint Kays radıyallahu anhâ şöyle demiştir: Nebî sallallahu aleyhi ve selleme geldim ve: Ebû Cehm ile Muâviye bana talip oldular, dedim. Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem buyurdu ki: "Muâviye'ye gelince, o malı olmayan yoksul biridir. Ebû Cehm'e gelince, sopayı omzundan indirmez." Müslim'in bir rivayetinde: "Ebû Cehm ise kadınları çok döver" şeklindedir. Bu, "sopayı omzundan indirmez" rivayetinin açıklamasıdır. Denildi ki: Bunun anlamı, onun çok yolculuk yapan biri olmasıdır.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Fatimah bint Qays, may Allah be pleased with her, said: I came to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and said: Abu al-Jahm and Mu'awiyah have proposed to me. The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: "As for Mu'awiyah, he is poor and has no wealth; and as for Abu al-Jahm, he does not put down the stick from his shoulder." In a narration of Muslim: "As for Abu al-Jahm, he is one who beats women often." This is an explanation of the narration: "He does not put down the stick from his shoulder." It was also said that its meaning is: he travels often.

items.text_en: Fatimah bint Qais (May Allah be pleased with her) said: I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said to him: "Muawiyah and Abul-Jahm sent me a proposal of marriage." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Muawiyah is destitute and he has no property, and Abul-Jahm is very hard on women.".

en.clean: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: A young man from the tribe of Aslam said, "O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), I wish to fight (in the Cause of Allah) but I do not have anything to equip myself with (for fighting)". He (the Prophet (ﷺ)) said, "Go to so- and-so, for he had equipped himself (for fighting) but he fell ill." So he (the young man) went to him and said, "Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sends you his greetings and says that you should give me the equipment that you have provided yourself with." The man said (to his wife or servant): "O so-and-so, give him the equipment I have collected for myself and do not withhold anything from him. By Allah, if you withhold anything from him, we will not be blessed therein".

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Enes’ten (radıyallahu anh) rivayet edildiğine göre Eslem kabilesinden bir genç şöyle dedi: “Ey Allah’ın Resûlü! Gazveye çıkmak istiyorum; fakat hazırlanacak imkânım yok.” Resûlullah (sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem), “Filan kimseye git; o hazırlanmıştı, sonra hastalandı” buyurdu. en.clean: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "A man (from amongst the people before you) said: 'Indeed! I will give in charity.' So he took his Sadaqah out and placed it in a thief's hand. In the morning the people were talking (about this incident) and saying: 'Sadaqah was given to a thief last night.' The man said: 'O Allah! Praise be to You. I have given Sadaqah to a thief. Indeed, I will give in charity!' So he took his Sadaqah out and he placed it in a prostitute's hand. In the morning the people were talking (about this incident) and saying: 'Sadaqah was given to a prostitute last night.' On hearing this, the man said: 'Praise be to You, O Allah! I gave Sadaqah to a prostitute. Indeed, I will give in charity!' So he took his Sadaqah out and placed it in a rich man's hand. In the morning the people were talking (about this incident) and saying: 'Sadaqah was given to a rich man last night.' The man said: 'O Allah! Praise be to You (for helping me) give charity to a thief, a prostitute and a rich man.' Then he had a dream in which he was told that his Sadaqah to the thief might result in his refraining from his theft, his Sadaqah to the prostitute might help her abstain from her immorality, and his Sadaqah to the rich man might help him pay heed and spend from what Allah had bestowed upon him.".

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Ebû Hüreyre radıyallahu anh’tan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: “Bir adam: ‘Mutlaka bir sadaka vereceğim.’ dedi. Sadakasını alıp çıktı ve onu bir hırsızın eline bıraktı. Sabah olunca insanlar: ‘Bir hırsıza sadaka verildi!’ diye konuşmaya başladılar. Adam: ‘Allah’ım, hamd sanadır; mutlaka bir sadaka vereceğim.’ dedi. Sadakasını alıp çıktı ve onu zina eden bir kadının eline bıraktı. Sabah olunca insanlar: ‘Zina eden bir kadına sadaka verildi!’ diye konuşmaya başladılar. Adam: ‘Allah’ım, zina eden bir kadına verilmiş olsa da hamd sanadır; mutlaka bir sadaka vereceğim.’ dedi. Sadakasını alıp çıktı ve onu zengin birinin eline bıraktı. Sabah olunca insanlar: ‘Bu gece bir zengine sadaka verildi!’ diye konuşmaya başladılar. Adam: ‘Allah’ım, hırsız üzerine, zina eden kadın üzerine ve zengin üzerine de hamd sanadır!’ dedi. Sonra kendisine gelinip şöyle denildi: ‘Hırsıza verdiğin sadakana gelince, belki o hırsızlığından vazgeçer. Zina eden kadına gelince, belki o zinasından vazgeçip iffetli olur. Zengine gelince, belki o ibret alır da Allah’ın kendisine verdiğinden infak eder.’”
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: It is narrated from Abū Hurayrah, may Allah be pleased with him, that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “A man said: ‘I will certainly give charity.’ He went out with his charity and placed it in the hand of a thief. In the morning people were saying: ‘Charity was given to a thief!’ He said: ‘O Allah, praise belongs to You; I will certainly give charity.’ He went out with his charity and placed it in the hand of a woman who committed fornication. In the morning people were saying: ‘Charity was given to a fornicating woman!’ He said: ‘O Allah, praise belongs to You, even for a fornicating woman; I will certainly give charity.’ He went out with his charity and placed it in the hand of a rich man. In the morning people were saying: ‘Tonight charity was given to a rich man!’ He said: ‘O Allah, praise belongs to You for a thief, for a fornicating woman, and for a rich man.’ Then it was said to him: ‘As for your charity to the thief, perhaps he will refrain from his theft; as for the fornicating woman, perhaps she will become chaste from her fornication; and as for the rich man, perhaps he will take heed and spend from what Allah has given him.’”

en.clean:
Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
The Prophet (ﷺ) drew up a square and in the middle of it he drew a line, the end of which jutted out beyond the square. Further across the middle line, he drew a number of smaller lines. Then he (ﷺ) said, "The figure represents man and the encircling square is the death which is encompassing him. The middle line represents his desires and the smaller lines are vicissitudes of life. If one of those misses him, another distresses him, and if that one misses him, he falls victim to another.".

en.clean: Ubayy bin Ka'b (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Abu Mundhir! Do you know which Ayah in Allah's Book is the greatest?" I replied: "It is 'Allah la ilaha illa Huwal-Haiyul-Qayum (Allah! none has the right to be worshipped but He, the Ever Living..)'." (2:256) Thereupon he (ﷺ) patted me in the chest and said, "Rejoice by this knowledge, O Abu Mundhir!".

Yanındaki Allah’ın Kitabı’ndan hangi âyetin en büyük olduğunu biliyor musun?” buyurdu. Ben: “Allah; O’ndan başka ilâh yoktur, O haydır, kayyûmdur” dedim. Bunun üzerine göğsüme vurdu ve: “İlim sana mübarek olsun, ey Ebû Münzir!” buyurdu.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Ubayy ibn Ka‘b, may Allah be pleased with him, said: The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said: “O Abū al-Mundhir, do you know which verse from the Book of Allah that you have is the greatest?” I said: “Allah—there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer.” He struck my chest and said: “May knowledge be pleasing and blessed for you, O Abū al-Mundhir.”
rawExcel.sunnah.com_arabic_full_text: وعن أبي بن كعب رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم :" يا أبا المنذر أتدري أي آية من كتاب الله معك أعظم ؟ قلت: الله لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم، فضرب في صدري وقال :" ليهنك العلم أبا المنذر".
rawExcel.turkish_full_text: Übey b. Ka’b (ra) anlatıyor: Resûlullah bana: “Yâ Ebâ’l-Münzîr, Allah’ın Kitabı’ndan ezberlediğin âyetlerin hangisinin daha büyük olduğunu biliyor musun?” diye sordu. Ben de “ Allâhü lâ ilâhe illâ hüve’l-hayyü’l-kayyûm” dedim. Bunun üzerine elini göğsüme vurarak, “İlmin mübarek olsun, yâ Ebâ’l-Münzîr” buyurdu.
rawExcel.english_full_text: Ubayy bin Ka'b (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Abu Mundhir! Do you know which Ayah in Allah's Book is the greatest?" I replied: "It is 'Allah la ilaha illa Huwal-Haiyul-Qayum (Allah! none has the right to be worshipped but He, the Ever Living..)'." (2:256) Thereupon he (ﷺ) patted me in the chest and said, "Rejoice by this knowledge, O Abu Mundhir!".

en.clean: Rib'i bin Hirash (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I accompanied Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari to Hudaifah bin Al-Yaman (May Allah be pleased with them). Abu Mas'ud said to him: "Tell us what you heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about Dajjal (the Antichrist)." Hudaifah said: He (ﷺ) said, "Dajjal will appear, and with him will be water and fire. That which people consider to be water will in fact be a burning fire, and that which people will consider to be fire will in fact be cool and sweet water. He who from amongst you happens to face him, should jump into that which he sees as fire for that will be nice and sweet water." Abu Mas'ud said: "I have also heard this from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)."

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Rib‘î b. Hırâş şöyle dedi: Ebû Mes‘ûd el-Ensârî ile birlikte Huzeyfe b. el-Yemân radıyallahu anhüm’ün yanına gittim. Ebû Mes‘ûd ona, “Bana Deccâl hakkında Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’den işittiğini anlat.” dedi. Huzeyfe şöyle dedi: “Deccâl çıkar; yanında su ve ateş bulunur. İnsanların su olarak gördüğü şey yakıcı bir ateştir; insanların ateş olarak gördüğü şey ise soğuk ve tatlı sudur. Sizden kim ona yetişirse, ateş olarak gördüğü şeye atsın kendini; çünkü o tatlı ve hoş sudur.” Ebû Mes‘ûd da, “Ben de bunu işittim.” dedi.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Rib‘i ibn Hirash said: I went with Abu Mas‘ud al-Ansari to Hudhayfah ibn al-Yaman (may Allah be pleased with them). Abu Mas‘ud said to him, “Tell me what you heard from the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) about the Dajjal.” He said: “The Dajjal will emerge, and with him will be water and fire. As for what people see as water, it is burning fire; and as for what people see as fire, it is cool, sweet water. Whoever among you reaches him should throw himself into what he sees as fire, for it is sweet, wholesome water.” Abu Mas‘ud said: “I too heard it.”

tr.clean: Rib’î b. Hıraş’ın şöyle dediği rivayet edilmiştir: (Bir gün) Ebû Mes’ûd el-Ensârî ile beraber Huzeyfe b. Yemân’a gittim. Ebû Mes’ûd, Huzeyfe’ye: –Deccal hakkında Resûlullah’tan işittiklerini bana da haber versen, dedi. Huzeyfe (ra) de: –(Bizzat Peygamber’den işittim), buyurdu ki: “(Ahir zamanda) Deccal çıkacak; yanında bir su, bir de ateş bulunacaktır. Fakat halkın soğuk su sandığı şey, yakıcı bir ateştir. en.clean: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Dajjal (the Antichrist) will come forth and a person from amongst the believers will go towards him and the armed watchmen of Dajjal will meet him and they will say to him: 'Where do you intend to go?' He will say: 'I intend to go to this one who has appeared.' They will say to him: 'Don't you believe in our lord (meaning Dajjal)?' He will say: 'There (i.e., we know Him to be Allah, Alone, without any partners) is nothing hidden about our Rubb.' Some of them will say: 'Let us kill him', but some others will say: 'Has your lord (Dajjal) not forbidden you to kill anyone without his consent?' So they will take him to Dajjal. When the believer will see him, he will say: 'O people! This is Dajjal about whom the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has informed us.' Dajjal will have him laid on his stomach and have his head. He will be struck on his back and on his stomach. Dajjal will ask him: 'Don't you believe in me?' He will say: 'You are the false Messiah.' He will then give his order to have him sawn with a saw into two from the parting of his hair up to his legs. After that Dajjal will walk between the two halves and will say to him: 'Stand up', and he will stand on his feet. He will then say to him: 'Don't you believe in me?' The person will say: 'It has added to my insight that you are Dajjal'. He will add: 'O people! He will not be able to behave with anyone amongst people in such a manner after me.' Dajjal will try to kill him. The space between his neck and collarbone will turn into copper and he will find no way to kill him. So he will catch hold of him by his hand and feet and throw him into (what appears to be the fire). The people will think that he has been thrown into the fire whereas he will be thrown into Jannah." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) added, "He will be the most eminent amongst the people with regard to martyrdom near the Rubb of the worlds."

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Ebû Saîd el-Hudrî radıyallahu anh’tan, Nebî sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’in şöyle buyurduğu rivayet edilmiştir: “Deccâl çıkar; müminlerden bir adam ona doğru yönelir. Deccâl’in muhafız ve öncü birlikleri onu karşılar ve ‘Nereye gidiyorsun?’ derler. O, ‘Ortaya çıkan şu adama gidiyorum.’ der. ‘Rabbimize iman etmiyor musun?’ derler. O da, ‘Rabbimiz hakkında gizlilik yoktur.’ der. ‘Onu öldürün.’ derler. Bir kısmı diğerlerine, ‘Rabbiniz size kendisi dışında birini öldürmenizi yasaklamadı mı?’ der. Onu Deccâl’e götürürler. Mümin onu görünce, ‘Ey insanlar! Bu, Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’in anlattığı Deccâl’dir.’ der. Deccâl onun yere yatırılmasını emreder; ‘Onu alın ve başını yarın.’ der. Sırtı ve karnı genişçe dövülür. Sonra, ‘Bana iman etmiyor musun?’ der. O, ‘Sen yalancı Mesih’sin!’ der. Bunun üzerine onun testereyle başının ortasından kesilip iki bacağının arasına kadar ikiye ayrılması emredilir. Sonra Deccâl iki parça arasında yürür ve ona, ‘Kalk!’ der; o da düzgünce ayağa kalkar. Sonra, ‘Bana iman ediyor musun?’ der. O, ‘Senin hakkında ancak basiretim arttı.’ der. Sonra, ‘Ey insanlar! O benden sonra insanlardan hiç kimseye bunu yapamayacaktır.’ der. Deccâl onu boğazlamak üzere tutar; Allah onun boynu ile köprücük kemiği arasını bakır kılar, bu yüzden ona yol bulamaz. Ellerinden ve ayaklarından tutup onu fırlatır. İnsanlar onu ateşe attığını sanırlar; oysa o cennete atılmıştır.” Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: “Bu, âlemlerin Rabbi katında insanların şehâdet bakımından en büyüğüdür.” Buhârî bunun bir kısmını mânasıyla rivayet etmiştir. “Mesâlih”, muhafızlar ve öncüler demektir.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Abu Sa‘id al-Khudri (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “The Dajjal will emerge, and a man from among the believers will go toward him. The guards and scouts of the Dajjal will meet him and say, ‘Where are you heading?’ He will say, ‘I am heading to this one who has emerged.’ They will say, ‘Do you not believe in our lord?’ He will say, ‘There is no obscurity regarding our Lord.’ They will say, ‘Kill him.’ Some of them will say to others, ‘Did your lord not forbid you to kill anyone besides him?’ So they will take him to the Dajjal. When the believer sees him, he will say, ‘O people, this is the Dajjal whom the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) mentioned.’ The Dajjal will command that he be stretched out and will say, ‘Take him and wound his head.’ His back and belly will be beaten severely. Then he will say, ‘Do you not believe in me?’ He will say, ‘You are the false Messiah.’ It will be commanded that he be sawed with a saw from the parting of his head until he is split between his legs. Then the Dajjal will walk between the two pieces and say to him, ‘Stand up,’ and he will stand upright. Then he will say, ‘Do you believe in me?’ He will say, ‘I have only increased in insight concerning you.’ Then he will say, ‘O people, he will not do this to anyone after me.’ The Dajjal will take him in order to slaughter him, but Allah will make what is between his neck and collarbone copper, so he will find no way to him. He will take him by his hands and feet and throw him. The people will think that he threw him into the Fire, but he will have been cast into Paradise.” The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “This is the greatest of people in testimony before the Lord of the worlds.” Al-Bukhari narrated part of it with its meaning. “Masalih” means guards and scouts.
rawExcel.sunnah.com_arabic_full_text: وعن أبي سعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: “يخرج الدجال فيتوجه قبله رجل من المؤمنين فيتلقاه المسالح: مسالح الدجال، فيقولون له: إلى أين تعمد؟ فيقول: أعمد إلى هذا الذي خرج فيقولون له أوَ ما تؤمن بربنا؟ فيقول: ما بربنا خفاء! فيقولون: اقتلوه، فيقول بعضهم لبعض: أليس قد نهاكم ربكم أن تقتلوا أحداً دونه، فينطلقون به إلى الدجال، فإذا رآه المؤمن قال: يا أيها الناس إن هذا الدجال الذي ذكر رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ؛ فيأمر الدجال به فيشبّح؛ فيقول: خذوه وشجوه، فيوسع ظهره وبطنه ضرباً، فيقول: أوَ ما تؤمن بي؟ فيقول: أنت المسيح الكذاب! فيؤمر به ، فيؤشر بالمنشار من مفرقه حتى يفرق بين رجليه، ثم يمشي الدجال بين القطعتين ، ثم يقول له: قم ، فيستوي قائماً، ثم يقول له: أتؤمن بي؟ فيقول: ما ازددت فيك إلا بصيرة، ثم يقول: يا أيها الناس إنه لا يفعل بعدي بأحد من الناس، فيأخذه الدجال ليذبحه، فيجعل الله ما بين رقبته إلى ترقوته نحاساً، فلا يستطيع إليه سبيلا، فيأخذ بيديه ورجليه فيقذف به، فيحسب الناس أنما قذفه إلى النار، وإنما ألقي في الجنة" فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "هذا أعظم الناس شهادة عند رب العالمين" وروى البخاري بعضه بمعناه “المسالح” :هم الخفراء والطلائع.

He will say: 'There (i.e., we know Him to be Allah, Alone, without any partners) is nothing hidden about our Rubb.' When the believer will see him, he will say: 'O people! This is Dajjal about whom the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has informed us.' Dajjal will have him laid on his stomach and have his head. He will be struck on his back and on his stomach. Dajjal will ask him: 'Don't you believe in me?' He will say: 'You are the false Messiah.' He will then give his order to have him sawn with a saw into two from the parting of his hair up to his legs. After that Dajjal will walk between the two halves and will say to him: 'Stand up', and he will stand on his feet. He will then say to him: 'Don't you believe in me?' The person will say: 'It has added to my insight that you are Dajjal'. He will add: 'O people! He will not be able to behave with anyone amongst people in such a manner after me.' Dajjal will try to kill him. The space between his neck and collarbone will turn into copper and he will find no way to kill him. So he will catch hold of him by his hand and feet and throw him into (what appears to be the fire). The people will think that he has been thrown into the fire whereas he will be thrown into Jannah." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) added, "He will be the most eminent amongst the people with regard to martyrdom near the Rubb of the worlds."

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Abdullah b. Dînâr’dan, Abdullah b. Ömer’den (r.a.) rivayet edildiğine göre Mekke yolunda bedevîlerden bir adam Abdullah b. Ömer’le karşılaştı. Abdullah ona selâm verdi, binmekte olduğu eşeğe onu bindirdi ve başındaki sarığı ona verdi. İbn Dînâr der ki: Biz ona “Allah seni ıslah etsin! Bunlar bedevîdir, az şeye razı olurlar” dedik. Abdullah b. Ömer şöyle dedi: “Bu adamın babası, Ömer b. el-Hattâb’ın (r.a.) dostuydu. Ben Resûlullah’ın (s.a.v.) ‘İyiliğin en üstünlerinden biri, kişinin babasının dostlarının ailesiyle ilişkiyi sürdürmesidir’ buyurduğunu işittim.” İbn Dînâr’dan, İbn Ömer’den gelen bir başka rivayette şöyle denir: İbn Ömer Mekke’ye çıktığında, deveye binmekten yorulduğunda dinlenmek için bindiği bir eşeği ve başını sardığı bir sarığı olurdu. Bir gün o eşeğin üzerindeyken bir bedevî yanından geçti. “Sen falan oğlu falan değil misin?” dedi. O da “Evet” dedi. Bunun üzerine eşeği ona verdi ve “Buna bin” dedi; sarığı da ona verip “Bununla başını sar” dedi. Arkadaşlarından bazıları ona “Allah seni bağışlasın! Dinlenmek için bindiğin eşeği ve başını sardığın sarığı bu bedevîye verdin!” dedi. İbn Ömer şöyle dedi: “Ben Resûlullah’ın (s.a.v.) ‘Kişinin, babası vefat ettikten sonra onun dostlarının ailesiyle ilişkiyi sürdürmesi iyiliğin en üstünlerindendir’ buyurduğunu işittim.” Onun babası da Ömer’in (r.a.) dostuydu.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: It is narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn Dīnār, from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar (may Allah be pleased with them both), that a man from the Bedouins met him on the road to Makkah. ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar greeted him with salām, seated him upon the donkey he had been riding, and gave him the turban that was on his head. Ibn Dīnār said: We said to him: “May Allah set you right! They are Bedouins and are content with little.” ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar said: “This man’s father was a friend of ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb (may Allah be pleased with him), and I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) say: ‘Among the most dutiful forms of righteousness is that a man maintain ties with the family of those whom his father loved.’” In another narration from Ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar: When he went out to Makkah, he had a donkey on which he would relax when he tired of riding the mount, and a turban with which he wrapped his head. One day, while he was on that donkey, a Bedouin passed by him. He said: “Are you not the son of so-and-so?” He said: “Yes.” So he gave him the donkey and said: “Ride this,” and he gave him the turban and said: “Wrap your head with it.” Some of his companions said to him: “May Allah forgive you! You gave this Bedouin the donkey on which you used to rest and the turban with which you wrapped your head.” He said: “I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) say: ‘Among the most dutiful forms of righteousness is that a man maintain ties with the family of those whom his father loved after he has passed away.’” And his father had been a friend of ʿUmar (may Allah be pleased with him).

en.clean: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Verily, Allah likes three things for you and disapproves three things for you. He likes that you should worship Him Alone, not to associate anything with Him (in worship) and to hold fast to the Rope of Allah and not to be divided among yourselves; and He disapproves for you irrelevant talk, persistent questioning and the squandering of the wealth.".

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Ebû Hüreyre radıyallahu anh şöyle demiştir: Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: “Allah Teâlâ sizin için üç şeyden razı olur ve sizin için üç şeyden hoşlanmaz: Sizin O’na ibadet etmenizden ve O’na hiçbir şeyi ortak koşmamanızdan, hep birlikte Allah’ın ipine sımsıkı sarılmanızdan ve ayrılığa düşmemenizden razı olur. Sizin için dedikodu mahiyetindeki ‘denildi, dedi’ sözlerinden, çok soru sormaktan ve malı zayi etmekten hoşlanmaz.”
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “Allah Most High is pleased for you with three things and dislikes for you three things: He is pleased for you that you worship Him and associate nothing with Him, that you hold fast all together to the rope of Allah and do not become divided. He dislikes for you ‘it was said and he said,’ excessive questioning, and wasting wealth.”

en.clean: Abu Hurairah (May Allah bepleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "A believer owes another believer five rights: responding to greetings, visiting him in illness, following his funeral, accepting his invitation, and saying 'Yarhamuk-Allah (May Allah have mercy on you),' when he says 'Al-hamdu lillah (Praise be to Allah)' after sneezing".Muslim's narration is, "There are six rights of a Muslim upon a Muslim: When you meet him, greet him; when he invites you, respond to him; when he seeks counsel, give him advice; when he sneezes and praises Allah, say to him: 'May Allah have mercy on you (Yarhamuk-Allah)'; when he is sick, visit him; and when he dies, follow his funeral".

en.clean: Al-Bara' bin 'Azib (May Allah bepleased with them) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) commanded us to observe seven things and forbade us seven. He ordered us to visit the sick; to follow funeral processions; to respond to a sneezer with 'Yarhamuk-Allah (May Allah have mercy on you)' when he says 'Al-hamdu lillah (Praise be to Allah),' to help the oppressed and to help others to fulfill their oaths, to accept invitation and to promote greeting. He forbade us to wear gold rings, to drink in silver utensils, to use Mayathir (silk carpets placed on saddles), to wear Al-Qassiy (a kind of silk cloth), and to wear fine silk brocade.

en.clean: Abu Umamah Sudaiy bin `Ajlan Al-Bahili (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The person nearest to Allah is one who is the first to offer greeting." . The narration in At-Tirmidhi is: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked: "O Messenger of Allah! When two persons meet, who should greet the other first?'' The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The person nearest to Allah (i.e., one who is more obedient and therefore closer to Allah will say: As-Salam first)."

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Ebû Saîd el-Hudrî radıyallahu anh'tan, Nebî sallallahu aleyhi ve sellemden rivayet edildiğine göre şöyle buyurmuştur: "Âdemoğlu sabaha çıktığında, organların hepsi dile karşı boyun eğer ve şöyle der: Bizim hakkımızda Allah'tan sakın; çünkü biz ancak seninle ayakta dururuz. Sen doğru olursan biz de doğru oluruz; sen eğrilirsen biz de eğriliriz." "Dil için tekfir eder" ifadesinin anlamı: ona boyun eğer ve onun karşısında alçalır, demektir.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, may Allah be pleased with him, reported from the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, that he said: "When the son of Adam enters the morning, all the limbs humble themselves before the tongue and say: Fear Allah concerning us, for we are only by you. If you are upright, we are upright; and if you become crooked, we become crooked." The meaning of "the limbs humble themselves before the tongue" is that they abase themselves and submit to it.

tr.clean: Enes’ten (ra) nakledildiğine göre, Resûlullah şöyle buyurmuştur: –Ben Mirac’a çıkarıldığımda bir topluluğun yanından geçtim. Bunlar bakırdan tırnaklarıyla yüzlerini ve göğüslerini tırmalıyorlardı. Bunun üzerine: –Yâ Cebrail, bunlar kimdir, dedim. –Bunlar, insanların etini yiyen (gıybet eden)ler, onların şeref ve onurlarına ilişenlerdir, cevabını verdi.

Amr radıyallahu anhümâ şöyle dedi: Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: “Kim ateşten uzaklaştırılıp cennete girmeyi isterse, ölümü kendisine Allah’a ve âhiret gününe iman eder hâlde gelsin; insanlara da kendisine yapılmasını sevdiği şeyi yapsın.” Bu, yöneticilere itaat bölümünde geçmiş olan uzun bir hadisin bir kısmıdır.

en.clean: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not harbour grudge against one another, nor jealousy, nor enmity; and do not show your backs to one another; and become as fellow brothers and slaves of Allah. rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Enes radıyallahu anh’tan rivayet edildiğine göre Nebî sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: “Birbirinize buğzetmeyin, birbirinizi kıskanmayın, birbirinize arka çevirmeyin, birbirinizle ilişkiyi kesmeyin. Ey Allah’ın kulları, kardeş olun. Bir Müslümanın kardeşini üç günden fazla terk etmesi helâl değildir.”
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Anas, may Allah be pleased with him, reported that the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said: “Do not hate one another, do not envy one another, do not turn away from one another, and do not sever relations with one another. Be, O servants of Allah, brothers. It is not lawful for a Muslim to forsake his brother for more than three days.”
rawExcel.sunnah.com_arabic_full_text: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "لا تباغضوا، ولا تحاسدوا ولا تدابروا، ولا تقاطعوا، وكونوا عباد الله إخوانًا، ولا يحل لمسلم أن يهجر أخاه فوق ثلاث"
rawExcel.turkish_full_text: Abdullah b. Amr b. Âs’tan (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah şöyle buyurmuştur: (Gerçek) müslüman, dilinden ve elinden Müslümanların güvende olduğu kimsedir. (Esas) muhacir (hicret eden) ise Allah’ın yasakladığı şeyleri terk edendir.
rawExcel.english_full_text: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not harbour grudge against one another, nor jealousy, nor enmity; and do not show your backs to one another; and become as fellow brothers and slaves of Allah. It is not lawful for a Muslim to avoid speaking with his brother beyond three days.".

items.text_tr: Ebû Eyyûb’den (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah şöyle buyurmuştur: Bir Müslümanın din kardeşine üç geceden fazla küs durması helâl olmaz. Onlar birbiriyle karşılaştığında birisi yüzünü şu tarafa, öbürü öte tarafa çevirir. Hâlbuki onların en hayırlısı, önce selâm vererek (konuşmaya) başlayandır.
items.text_en: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying, "The Satan has despaired of being worshipped by those who engage in prayer in the Arabian Peninsula but (has not lost hope) in creating dissension among them.".

ar.clean: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أن يبيع حاضر لباد، ولا تناجشوا ولا يبيع الرجل على بيع أخيه، ولا يخطب على خطبة أخيه، ولا تسأل المرأة طلاق أختها لتكفأ ما في إنائها. وفي رواية قال: نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن التلقي وأن يبتاع المهاجر للأعرابي، وأن تشترط المرأة طلاق أختها، وأن يستام الرجل على سوم أخيه، ونهى عن النجش والتصرية"

en.clean: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade that a man in the city should be the commission agent of a man from the desert and prohibited the practice of Najsh (i.e., offering a high price for something in order to allure another customer who is interested in the thing); and that a man should make an offer while the offer of his brother is pending; or that he should make a proposal of marriage while that of his brother is pending; or that a woman should try that a sister of hers might be divorced so that she might take her place.Another narration is: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade the people from meeting the caravan on the way for entering into business transaction with them; and the selling of the goods by a dweller of the city on behalf of a man of the desert; and the seeking by a woman the divorce of her sister (from her husband); and the practice of Najsh and leaving the animals unmilked (for sometime for the purpose of accumulation of milk to deceive the buyer).

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Ebû Hüreyre radıyallahu anh şöyle demiştir: Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem, şehirlinin bedevî adına satış yapmasını yasakladı; birbirinizi aldatmak için fiyat artırmayın; kişi kardeşinin satışı üzerine satış yapmasın, kardeşinin dünürlüğü üzerine dünürlük yapmasın; kadın da kız kardeşinin kabındakini boşaltmak için onun boşanmasını istemesin. Bir rivayette şöyle demiştir: Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem yolda karşılamayı, muhacirin bedevî adına alışveriş yapmasını, kadının kız kardeşinin boşanmasını şart koşmasını, kişinin kardeşinin pazarlığı üzerine pazarlık yapmasını yasakladı; neceş ve tasriyeyi de yasakladı.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) forbade a town-dweller to sell on behalf of a bedouin; do not practise najsh, bidding up prices deceptively; a man must not sell over the sale of his brother; he must not propose over the proposal of his brother; and a woman must not ask for her sister’s divorce in order to empty what is in her vessel. In another narration he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) forbade going out to meet goods, a Muhajir buying or selling on behalf of a bedouin, a woman stipulating the divorce of her sister, a man bargaining over the bargain of his brother, and he forbade najsh and tasriyah.

en.clean: Abu Zaid Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak Al-Ansari (May Allah be pleased with him( (he is one of those who gave their pledge of allegiance to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) under the Tree) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who swears by a religion other than that of Islam, is like what he has professed. Cursing a believer is like murdering him.".

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Rıdvân Biatı’na katılanlardan olan Ebû Zeyd Sâbit b. Dahhâk el-Ensârî radıyallahu anh’tan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: “Kim İslâm’dan başka bir din adına, yalan söyleyerek ve kasten yemin ederse, söylediği gibidir. Kim kendini bir şeyle öldürürse, kıyamet günü onunla azap edilir. Kişinin sahip olmadığı şey hakkında adak adaması geçerli değildir. Mü’mine lanet etmek onu öldürmek gibidir.”
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Abu Zayd Thabit ibn al-Dahhak al-Ansari, may Allah be pleased with him, who was among the people of the Pledge of al-Ridwan, reported that the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said: “Whoever swears an oath by a religion other than Islam, lying deliberately, then he is as he said. Whoever kills himself with something will be punished with it on the Day of Resurrection. A man has no valid vow concerning what he does not possess. Cursing a believer is like killing him.”

ar.clean: وَعَنْ حميْدِ بن عبْدِ الرَّحْمن أنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُعاويَةَ رضي اللَّه عنْهُ عامَ حجَّ علَى المِنْبَر وَتَنَاول قُصَّةً مِنْ شَعْرٍ كَانَتْ في يَدِ حَرِسيٍّ فَقَالَ: يَا أهْل المَدِينَةِ أيْنَ عُلَمَاؤكُمْ؟، سمِعْتُ النبيَّ صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وسَلَّم يَنْهَى عنْ مِثْلِ هَذِهِ ويقُولُ: "إنًَّمَا هَلَكَتْ بنُو إسْرَائِيل حِينَ اتخذ هذه نِسَاؤُهُمْ" متفقٌ عليه.

en.clean: Humaid bin 'Abdur-Rahman (May Allah be pleased wth him) said: I saw Mu'awiyah (May Allah be pleased with him) during the Hajj (pilgrimage) standing on the pulpit. He took from the guard a bunch of hair, and said: "O people of Al-Madinah! Where are your scholars? (Why do they do not prohibit you) I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) prohibiting from using this (false hair) and saying, 'The people of Bani Israel were ruined when their women wore such hair."'

Abdurrahman’dan rivayet edildiğine göre o, Muâviye radıyallahu anh’ın hac yaptığı yıl minber üzerinde konuşurken, bir muhafızın elinde bulunan saçtan bir tutamı alıp şöyle dediğini işitmiştir: “Ey Medine halkı! Âlimleriniz nerede? Ben Nebî sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’in bunun gibisini yasakladığını ve şöyle buyurduğunu işittim: ‘İsrâiloğulları ancak kadınları bunu edindikleri zaman helâk oldu.’” Müttafakun aleyh.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman reported that he heard Mu‘awiyah, may Allah be pleased with him, during the year in which he performed Hajj, speaking on the minbar. He took a lock of hair that was in the hand of a guard and said: “O people of Madinah, where are your scholars? I heard the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, forbid the like of this and say: ‘The Children of Israel were destroyed only when their women adopted this.’” Agreed upon.

ar.clean: فالأول عن ابن مسعود رضي الله عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "إن الصدق يهدي إلى البر وإن البر يهدي إلى الجنة، وإن الرجل ليصدق حتى يكتب عند الله صديقاً، وإن الكذب يهدي إلى الفجور، وإن الفجور يهدي إلى النار، وإن الرجل ليكذب حتى يكتب عند الله كذاباً"
ar.sourceText: فالأول عن ابن مسعود رضي الله عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "إن الصدق يهدي إلى البر وإن البر يهدي إلى الجنة، وإن الرجل ليصدق حتى يكتب عند الله صديقاً، وإن الكذب يهدي إلى الفجور، وإن الفجور يهدي إلى النار، وإن الرجل ليكذب حتى يكتب عند الله كذاباً"

tr.clean: İbn Mes’ûd’dan (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Peygamber şöyle demiştir: Doğruluk iyiliğe, iyilik de cennete götürür. en.clean: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "My parable and that of yours is like a man who kindled a fire. When it has illuminated all around him, the moths and grasshoppers began to fall therein. He tried to push them away, but they overcame him and jumped into it. ar.clean: وعنه عن النبي، صلى الله عليه وسلم، قال: "إذا أحب الله العبد نادى جبريل: إن الله تعالى يحب فلانًا، فأحببه، فيحبه جبريل، فينادي في أهل السماء: إن الله يحب فلانًا، فأحبوه، فيحبه أهل السماء، ثم يوضع له القبول في الأرض" وفي رواية لمسلم : قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "إن الله تعالى إذا أحب عبدًا دعا جبريل، فقال : إني أحب فلانًا فأحببه، فيحبه جبريل، ثم ينادي في السماء، فيقول: إن الله يحب فلانًا، فأحبوه فيحبه أهل السماء، ثم يوضع له القبول في الأرض، وإذا أبغض عبدًا دعا جبريل فيقول: إني أبغض فلانًا، فأبغضه، فيبغضه جبريل، ثم ينادي في أهل السماء، إن الله يبغض فلانًا، فأبغضوه، ثم توضع له البغضاء في الأرض".

tr.clean: Ebû Hüreyre’den (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah şöyle buyurmuştur: Allah Teâlâ, “Kim benim dostlarımdan birine düşmanlık ederse, ben de ona harp açarım. Bir kulum, kendisine farz kıldığım şeylerden daha sevimli bir amel ve ibadetle bana yaklaşmaz. Fakat kulum bana nafile ibadetlerle de sürekli yaklaşır, sonunda ben onu severim. Bir kere de onu sevdim mi, artık o kulumun işiten kulağı, gören gözü, tutan eli ve yürüyen ayağı olurum. Eğer benden bir şey dilerse onu verir; bana sığınırsa mutlaka onu himaye ederim.” buyurdu.

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Yine Ebû Hüreyre’den (radıyallahu anh), Nebî’den (sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem) şöyle rivayet edilmiştir: “Allah bir kulu sevdiğinde Cebrâil’e: ‘Allah falanı seviyor; sen de onu sev’ diye seslenir. Cebrâil onu sever. Sonra gök ehline: ‘Allah falanı seviyor; siz de onu sevin’ diye seslenir. Gök ehli de onu sever. Sonra onun için yeryüzünde kabul konulur.” Müslim’in bir rivayetinde Resûlullah şöyle buyurmuştur: “Allah Teâlâ bir kulu sevdiğinde Cebrâil’i çağırır ve: ‘Ben falanı seviyorum; sen de onu sev’ buyurur. Cebrâil onu sever. Sonra gökte seslenir: ‘Allah falanı seviyor; siz de onu sevin.’ Gök ehli de onu sever. Sonra onun için yeryüzünde kabul konulur. Bir kula buğzettiğinde ise Cebrâil’i çağırır ve: ‘Ben falana buğzediyorum; sen de ona buğzet’ buyurur. Cebrâil ona buğzeder. Sonra gök ehline: ‘Allah falana buğzediyor; siz de ona buğzedin’ diye seslenir. Sonra onun için yeryüzünde buğz konulur.”
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: He also reported from the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him): “When Allah loves a servant, He calls Jibril: Allah loves so-and-so, so love him. Jibril loves him. Then he calls out among the inhabitants of heaven: Allah loves so-and-so, so love him. The inhabitants of heaven love him. Then acceptance is placed for him on earth.” In a narration of Muslim, the Messenger of Allah said: “When Allah, Most High, loves a servant, He calls Jibril and says: I love so-and-so, so love him. Jibril loves him. Then he calls out in heaven, saying: Allah loves so-and-so, so love him. The inhabitants of heaven love him. Then acceptance is placed for him on earth. When He hates a servant, He calls Jibril and says: I hate so-and-so, so hate him. Jibril hates him. Then he calls out among the inhabitants of heaven: Allah hates so-and-so, so hate him. Then hatred is placed for him on earth.”

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Ebû Hüreyre radıyallahu anh şöyle dedi: Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: “Bir erkek eşini yatağına çağırır da kadın gelmez ve erkek ona öfkeli olarak geceyi geçirirse, melekler sabaha kadar ona lanet eder.” Bir başka rivayette: “Kadın, kocasının yatağını terk ederek geceyi geçirirse, melekler sabaha kadar ona lanet eder.” Başka bir rivayette ise Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: “Nefsim elinde olana yemin ederim ki bir erkek eşini yatağına çağırır da kadın ona karşılık vermezse, gökte olan, kocası ondan razı oluncaya kadar ona gazap eder.”
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Abu Hurayrah, may Allah be pleased with him, said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “If a man calls his wife to his bed and she does not come, and he spends the night angry with her, the angels curse her until morning.” In another narration: “If a woman spends the night abandoning her husband’s bed, the angels curse her until morning.” In another narration, the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “By the One in Whose hand is my soul, no man calls his wife to his bed and she refuses him except that the One in heaven is displeased with her until he is pleased with her.”

items.text_ar: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم :"إذا دعا الرجل امرأته إلى فراشه فلم تأته فبات غضبان عليها لعنتها الملائكة حتى تصبح" وفي رواية لها "إذا باتت المرأة هاجرة فراش زوجها لعنتها الملائكة حتى تصبح". وفي رواية قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : " والذي نفسي بيده ما من رجل يدعو امرأته إلى فراشه فتأبى عليه إلا كان الذي في السماء ساخطًا عليها حتى يرضي عنها".
items.text_tr: İbn Ömer’den (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Hz. Peygamber şöyle buyurmuştur: Hepiniz sorumlusunuz ve hepiniz gözetiminizde bulunanlardan mesulsünüz. Yönetici sorumludur. Evin erkeği, aile efradından sorumludur. Evin hanımı da kocasının evinden ve çocuklarından sorumludur. Hülâsa, hepiniz sorumlusunuz ve hepiniz gözetiminizde bulunanlardan mesulsünüz.
items.text_en: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When a man calls his wife to his bed, and she does not respond and he (the husband) spends the night angry with her, the angels curse her until morning".

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Ebû Mes‘ûd Ukbe b. Amr el-Bedrî el-Ensârî’den (r.a.) rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah (s.a.v.) şöyle buyurmuştur: “Bir topluluğa, Allah’ın Kitabı’nı en iyi okuyanları imamlık eder. Kıraatte eşit iseler sünneti en iyi bilenleri; sünnette eşit iseler hicrette en önce olanları; hicrette eşit iseler yaşça en büyükleri imamlık eder. Bir kimse, başka bir kimseye onun yetki alanında imamlık etmesin ve onun evindeki özel yerine ancak izniyle oturmasın.” Müslim’in bir rivayetinde “yaşça en büyükleri” yerine “İslâm’a girişte en önce olanları” yahut “Müslümanlıkta en önce olanları” lafzı vardır. Bir rivayette de: “Bir topluluğa Allah’ın Kitabı’nı en iyi okuyan ve kıraatte en önde olanları imamlık eder. Kıraatleri eşit olursa hicrette en önce olanları; hicrette eşit olurlarsa yaşça en büyükleri imamlık etsin” buyrulmuştur.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: It is narrated from Abū Masʿūd ʿUqbah ibn ʿAmr al-Badrī al-Anṣārī (may Allah be pleased with him) that the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “The people should be led in prayer by the one among them who is most versed in reciting the Book of Allah. If they are equal in recitation, then the one most knowledgeable of the Sunnah; if they are equal in the Sunnah, then the earliest of them in hijrah; if they are equal in hijrah, then the oldest of them. A man must not lead another man in his sphere of authority, nor sit in his place of honor in his house except with his permission.” In one narration of Muslim: “the earliest of them in Islam” or “the earliest in submission” occurs in place of “the oldest.” In another narration: “The people should be led by the one most versed in the Book of Allah and foremost in recitation; if their recitation is equal, then the earliest of them in hijrah; if they are equal in hijrah, then let the oldest of them lead them.”

en.clean: Abu Hurairah (May Allah bepleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who has done a wrong affecting his brother's honour or anything else, let him ask his forgiveness today before the time (i.e., the Day of Resurrection) when he will have neither a dinar nor a dirham. If he has done some good deeds, a portion equal to his wrong doings will be subtracted from them; but if he has no good deeds, he will be burdened with the evil deeds of the one he had wronged in the same proportion".

en.clean: Asma bint Yazid (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by us when we were with a party of women, and he greeted us with salam. This is the wording of Abu Dawud. en.clean: Sahl bin Sa'd As-Sa'idi (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: A man passed by the Prophet (ﷺ), so he asked a man who was sitting near him, "What is your opinion about this man?" That man replied: "He is one of the noblest men. By Allah he is certainly a proper person for (a girl) being given in marriage if he seeks to marry, and his recommendation is fit to be accepted if he recommends". Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remained silent. Then another man passed. Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) enquired, "What is your opinion about this man?" He replied: "O Messenger of Allah, he is one of the poor Muslims. He is not a proper person (for a girl) to be given in marriage to, and his recommendation would not be accepted if he makes one; if he speaks, he is not to be listened to." Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He is better than the former by earthfuls".

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Ebû’l-Abbâs Sehl b. Sa‘d es-Sâidî radıyallahu anh şöyle dedi: Bir adam Peygamber sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’in yanından geçti. Nebî sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem yanında oturan bir adama: “Bu kişi hakkında görüşün nedir?” buyurdu. O da: “İnsanların itibarlılarından biridir; vallahi, evlenmek istese evlendirilir, aracılık etse aracılığı kabul edilir” dedi. Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem sustu. Sonra başka bir adam geçti. Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem: “Bu kişi hakkında görüşün nedir?” buyurdu. O da: “Ey Allah’ın Resûlü! Bu, Müslümanların fakirlerinden bir adamdır; evlenmek istese evlendirilmemeye, aracılık etse aracılığı kabul edilmemeye, konuşsa sözü dinlenmemeye layıktır” dedi. Bunun üzerine Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem: “Bu kişi, yeryüzünü dolduracak kadar ötekisi gibilerden daha hayırlıdır” buyurdu.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Abu al-‘Abbas Sahl ibn Sa‘d al-Sa‘idi, may Allah be pleased with him, said: A man passed by the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him. He said to a man sitting with him: “What is your opinion of this man?” He replied: “He is a man of the nobles of the people. By Allah, if he seeks marriage, he deserves to be married; and if he intercedes, his intercession deserves to be accepted.” The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, remained silent. Then another man passed by, and the Messenger of Allah said to him: “What is your opinion of this man?” He replied: “O Messenger of Allah, this is a man from among the poor Muslims. If he seeks marriage, he deserves not to be married; if he intercedes, his intercession deserves not to be accepted; and if he speaks, his word deserves not to be heard.” The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “This man is better than an earth-full of the likes of the other.”

items.text_ar: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "ليس الشديد بالصرعة، إنما الشديد الذى يملك نفسه عند الغضب"
items.text_tr: Ebû Hüreyre’den (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah şöyle demiştir: Güçlü kimse, insanları güreşte yenen değil, bilakis öfke anında kendisini tutan, iradesine sahip olandır.
items.text_en: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The strong man is not one who is good at wrestling, but the strong man is one who controls himself in a fit of rage.".

en.clean: Hudhaifah and Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with them) reported that they heard Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Allah will assemble mankind, and the believers will stand till Jannah will be brought near them. They will then go to Adam (ﷺ) and say, `O our father, ask (Allah (SWT), that Jannah may be opened for us, but he will reply: `There was nothing that put you out of Jannah except your father's sin. I am not the one to do that, go to my son Ibrahim (Abraham), the beloved man of Allah.' Then Ibrahim (ﷺ) when approached, will say: `I am not the one to do that, for I was only a friend; and that is not a lofty status but ask Musa (Moses) to whom Allah spoke.' They will then go to Musa (ﷺ) but he will say: `I am not the one to do that; go to `Isa (Jesus), Allah's Word and spirit.' `Isa (ﷺ) will say: `I am not the one to do that.' So they will come to me; and I will stand and be given permission. Amanah and ties of relationship will be sent forth and will stand on the sides of the Sirat (that is, the Bridge set over Hell-fire) right and left, and the first of you will pass like lightning.'' I said (that is Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him)" :I ransom you with my father and mother, what is like the movement of lightning?'' The Messenger of Allah replied, "Have you not seen how the lightning goes and returns in the twinkling of an eye? Next (group will pass) like the passing of the breeze, next like the passing of a bird, and the next with the speed of a running man, according to the quality of their deeds. (During all this time) your Prophet (ﷺ) will remain standing on the Bridge saying: `O my Rubb, keep (them) safe, keep (them) safe,' till men's deeds are so weak that a man comes who will be able only to crawl. On both sides of the Bridge pronged flesh hooks, placed under command will be hung and will seize those about whom they receive command, some people being lacerated and escaping and others being thrown violently into Hell.'' Abu Hurairah added: By Him in Whose Hand Abu Hurairah's soul is, the pit of Jahannam (Hell) is seventy years in depth.

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Huzeyfe ve Ebû Hüreyre (r.a.) rivayet ettiler: Resûlullah (s.a.v.) şöyle buyurdu: Allah Teâlâ insanları toplar. Müminler ayağa kalkar; cennet onlara yaklaştırılır. Âdem'e gelip: ‘Ey babamız, bizim için cennetin açılmasını iste’ derler. O: ‘Sizi cennetten çıkaran, babanızın hatasından başkası mıydı? Ben bunun sahibi değilim; Allah’ın dostu olan oğlum İbrâhim’e gidin’ der. İbrâhim’e gelirler; o da: ‘Ben bunun sahibi değilim; Allah’ın bizzat konuştuğu Mûsâ’ya gidin’ der. Mûsâ’ya gelirler; o da: ‘Ben bunun sahibi değilim; Allah’ın kelimesi ve ruhu olan Îsâ’ya gidin’ der. Îsâ da: ‘Ben bunun sahibi değilim’ der. Bunun üzerine Muhammed’e (s.a.v.) gelirler. O kalkar ve kendisine izin verilir. Emanet ve akrabalık bağı gönderilir; sıratın iki yanında, sağında ve solunda dururlar. Sizden ilk geçen şimşek gibi geçer.’ Dedim ki: ‘Anam babam sana feda olsun, şimşek gibi geçmek nasıl olur?’ Buyurdu ki: ‘Şimşeğin göz açıp kapayıncaya kadar nasıl gidip geldiğini görmediniz mi? Sonra rüzgâr gibi, sonra kuş gibi, sonra da en güçlü yürüyüş sahibi kimseler gibi geçerler; onları amelleri yürütür. Peygamberiniz sırat üzerinde durup: “Rabbim, selamet ver; Rabbim, selamet ver” der. Nihayet kulların amelleri zayıflar; öyle ki bir kimse ancak sürünerek gelebilir. Sıratın iki kenarında, yakalamakla emredildikleri kimseleri almak üzere asılı çengeller vardır. Kimi yaralanmış hâlde kurtulur; kimi de cehenneme yığılır.’ Ebû Hüreyre’nin canı elinde olana yemin olsun ki cehennemin dibi yetmiş yıllık mesafedir.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Hudhayfah and Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said: Allah, Blessed and Exalted, will gather the people. The believers will stand until Paradise is brought near to them. They will come to Adam and say: ‘Our father, ask that Paradise be opened for us.’ He will say: ‘Was it anything but the sin of your father that brought you out of Paradise? I am not the one for that; go to my son Abraham, the intimate friend of Allah.’ They will come to Abraham, and he will say: ‘I am not the one for that; go to Moses, to whom Allah spoke directly.’ They will come to Moses, and he will say: ‘I am not the one for that; go to Jesus, the Word of Allah and His spirit.’ Jesus will say: ‘I am not the one for that.’ Then they will come to Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him). He will stand, and permission will be granted to him. Trust and kinship will be sent and will stand on the two sides of the Bridge, to its right and its left. The first of you will pass like lightning.’ I said: ‘May my father and mother be sacrificed for you, what is passing like lightning?’ He said: ‘Have you not seen how lightning passes and returns in the blink of an eye? Then like the wind, then like birds, then like the swiftest men; their deeds will carry them. Your Prophet will stand upon the Bridge saying: “My Lord, grant safety; my Lord, grant safety.” Then the deeds of the servants will become insufficient, until a man will come unable to move except by crawling. On the two edges of the Bridge there will be hooks suspended, commanded to seize those whom they are commanded to seize. Some will be scratched yet saved, and some will be hurled into the Fire.’ By the One in Whose hand is Abu Hurayrah’s soul, the depth of Hell is seventy autumns.

In another narration he said: “Include us in your supplication, my brother.”

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Abdurrahman b. Semüre radıyallahu anh şöyle demiştir: Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: “Tâğîler adına ve babalarınız adına yemin etmeyin.” “Tâğîler”, tâğiye kelimesinin çoğuludur; putlar demektir. “Bu, Devs kabilesinin tâğiyesidir” hadisinde de bu anlam vardır; yani onların putu ve mabudu demektir. Müslim dışındaki bir rivayette “tâğûtlar adına” şeklinde gelmiştir. Tâğûtun çoğuludur; şeytan ve put demektir.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn Samurah (may Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “Do not swear by the tawaghi, nor by your fathers.” “Al-tawaghi” is the plural of taghiyah, meaning idols. From this is the hadith: “This is the taghiyah of Daws,” meaning their idol and object of worship. In a narration outside Muslim it is reported as “by the tawaghit,” the plural of taghut, which is the devil and the idol.

en.clean: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Between the two Blowing of the Trumpet there will be an interval of forty." The people said, "O Abu Hurairah! Do you mean forty days?" He said, "I cannot say anything." They said, "Do you mean forty years?" He said, "I cannot say anything." They said, "Do you mean forty months?" He said, "I cannot say anything. The Prophet added: 'Everything of the human body will perish except the last coccyx bone (end part of the spinal cord), and from that bone Allah will reconstruct the whole body. Then Allah will send down water from the sky and people will grow like green vegetables'.".

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Yine Ebû Hüreyre radıyallahu anh’tan, Nebî sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’in şöyle buyurduğu rivayet edilmiştir: “İki üfürme arasında kırk vardır.” Onlar, “Ey Ebû Hüreyre, kırk gün mü?” dediler. O, “Cevap vermekten kaçındım.” dedi. “Kırk yıl mı?” dediler. “Cevap vermekten kaçındım.” dedi. “Kırk ay mı?” dediler. “Cevap vermekten kaçındım.” dedi. “İnsanın her şeyi çürür; ancak kuyruk sokumu kemiği müstesna. Yaratılış onun üzerinden yeniden kurulur. Sonra Allah gökten bir su indirir; onlar da bitkinin bitmesi gibi biterler.”
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: He reported from the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) that he said: “Between the two blasts there are forty.” They said: “O Abu Hurayrah, forty days?” He said: “I refused to answer.” They said: “Forty years?” He said: “I refused to answer.” They said: “Forty months?” He said: “I refused to answer.” “Everything of the human being decays except the tailbone; from it the creation is reassembled. Then Allah sends down water from the sky, and they grow as herbage grows.”

en.clean: 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I donated a horse in the way of Allah. Its new possessor did not treat it properly. I made my mind to buy it because I thought that he would sell it at a cheap price (now that it became weak and emaciated). I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about it, whereupon he said, "Do not buy it and do not get back your charity, for one who gets back the charity is like a dog that eats its own vomit."

Onu satın almak istedim ve ucuza satacağını zannettim. Nebî sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’e sordum. O da şöyle buyurdu: “Onu satın alma ve sadakana geri dönme; sana bir dirheme verse bile. Çünkü sadakasına dönen kimse, kusmuğuna dönen kimse gibidir.” “Allah yolunda bir at verdim” sözünün anlamı: onu mücahitlerden birine sadaka olarak verdim, demektir.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, said: I provided a horse for use in the path of Allah, but the one who had it neglected it. I wanted to buy it, thinking that he would sell it cheaply, so I asked the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace. He said: “Do not buy it, and do not return to your charity, even if he gives it to you for one dirham; for the one who returns to his charity is like one who returns to his vomit.” His saying, “I provided a horse in the path of Allah,” means: I gave it in charity to one of the fighters.
rawExcel.sunnah.com_arabic_full_text: وعن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه قال: حملت على فرس في سبيل الله فأضاعه الذي كان عنده، فأردت أن أشتريه، وظننت أنه يبيعه برخص، فسألت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال: "لا تشتره ولا تعد في صدقتك وإن أعطاكه بدرهم، فإن العائد في صدقته كالعائد في قيئه" قوله: "حملت على فرس في سبيل الله" معناه: تصدقت به على بعض المجاهدين.
rawExcel.turkish_full_text: Ebû Hüreyre’den (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah şöyle buyurmuştur: Zenginin, borcunu geciktirmesi zulümdür. Biriniz (alacağının ödenmesi için) durumu iyi olan birine havale edildiğinde, ona başvursun.
rawExcel.english_full_text: 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I donated a horse in the way of Allah. Its new possessor did not treat it properly. I made my mind to buy it because I thought that he would sell it at a cheap price (now that it became weak and emaciated). I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about it, whereupon he said, "Do not buy it and do not get back your charity, for one who gets back the charity is like a dog that eats its own vomit."

en.clean: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Keep away from the seven fatalities." It was asked: "What are they, O Messenger of Allah?" He (ﷺ) replied, "Associating anything with Allah in worship (i.e., committing an act of Shirk), sorcery, killing of one whom Allah has declared inviolable without a just cause, devouring the property of an orphan, the eating of usury (Riba), fleeing from the battlefield and accusing chaste believing women, who never even think of anything touching their chastity.".

ar.clean: وعن أبي عبد الرحمن بلال بن الحارث المزني رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏"‏إن الرجل ليتكلم بالكلمة من رضوان الله تعالى ما كان يظن أن تبلغ ما بلغت يكتب الله له بها رضوانه إلى يوم يلقاه، وإن الرجل ليتكلم بالكلمة من سخط الله ما كان يظن أن تبلغ ما بلغت يكتب الله له بها سخطه إلى يوم يلقاه”‏.‏ رواه مالك في الموطأ والترمذي وقال حديث حسن صحيح‏.‏

Ebû Abdurrahmân Bilâl b. Hâris el-Müzenî’den (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah şöyle buyurmuştur:
Kişi, Allah’ın rızasına ulaşacağını düşünmeden O’nun hoşlanacağı bir söz söyler. Bu sebeple Allah o kimseden, karşılaşacağı güne kadar razı olduğunu yazar.

Abu 'Abdur-Rahman Bilal bin Al-Harith Al-Muzani (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "A man speaks a good word without knowing its worth, Allah records for him His Good Pleasure till the day he will meet Him; and a man utters an evil word without realizing its importance, Allah records for him His displeasure till the day he will meet Him.".

Sonra şöyle desin: ‘Rabbim, Senin adınla yanımı koydum ve Senin yardımınla onu kaldırırım. Nefsimi tutarsan ona rahmet et; onu salıverirsen salih kullarını koruduğun şeyle onu koru.’”
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Abu Hurayrah, may Allah be pleased with him, said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “When one of you retires to his bed, let him dust off his bed with the inner side of his lower garment, for he does not know what came upon it after him. Then let him say: ‘In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, and by You I raise it. If You hold my soul, then have mercy on it; and if You release it, then protect it with that by which You protect Your righteous servants.’”

en.clean: 'Abdullah bin Ash-Shikhkhir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was reciting (Surat At-Takathur 102):"The mutual rivalry (for hoarding worldly things) preoccupy you. Until you visit the graves (i.e., till you die). Nay! You shall come to know! Again nay! You shall come to know! Nay! If you knew with a sure knowledge (the end result of hoarding, you would not have been occupied in worldly things). Verily, you shall see the blazing Fire (Hell)! And again, you shall see it with certainty of sight! Then (on that Day) you shall be asked about the delights (you indulged in, in this world)!" (102:1-8)(After reciting) he (ﷺ) said, "Son of adam says: 'My wealth, my wealth.' Do you own of your wealth other than what you eat and consume, and what you wear and wear out, or what you give in Sadaqah (charity) (to those who deserve it), and that what you will have in stock for yourself.".

en.clean: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The best of people is a man who is holding his horse's rein in the way of Allah (in Jihad) and is galloping towards the place wherever he hears a call for war or detects a note of danger; he goes on proceeding, seeking martyrdom or death wherever it is expected. And a man who retires with some sheep in a mountainside or a valley. He performs Salat regularly and pays the Zakat, continues worshipping his Rubb, till death overtakes him. He does not interfere in the affairs of the people except for betterment.".

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Yine Ebû Hüreyre radıyallahu anh'den, Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem'den rivayet edildiğine göre şöyle buyurdu: “İnsanların geçimlerinin en hayırlılarından biri, Allah yolunda atının dizginini tutan kimsedir; onun sırtında hızla gider. Her ne zaman bir yardım çağrısı yahut korku sesi işitse, ölümün veya öldürülmenin bulunabileceği yerlere onu sürer. Yahut şu dağ tepelerinden birinin başında veya şu vadilerden bir vadinin içinde küçük bir koyun sürüsü bulunan; namazı kılan, zekâtı veren ve kendisine yakîn gelinceye kadar Rabbine ibadet eden kimsedir. O, insanlara ancak hayır içindedir.”
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: It is narrated from him, from the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, that he said: “Among the best livelihoods of people is a man holding the rein of his horse in the way of Allah, flying upon its back; whenever he hears a call for help or alarm, he flies upon it, seeking killing or death in its likely places. Or a man with a small flock at the top of one of these mountain peaks, or in the bottom of one of these valleys, who establishes prayer, gives zakat, and worships his Lord until certainty comes to him. He is only among people in goodness.”
rawExcel.sunnah.com_arabic_full_text: وعنه عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال: “من خير معاش الناس رجل ممسك عنان فرسه فى سبيل الله، يطير على متنه، كلما سمع هيعه أو فزعة، طار عليه يبتغى القتل، أو الموت مظانه، أو رجل فى غنيمة فى رأس شعفة من هذه الشعف، أو بطن واد من هذه الأودية يقيم الصلاة، ويؤتى الزكاة، ويعبد ربه حتى يأتيه اليقين، ليس من الناس إلا فى خير”
rawExcel.turkish_full_text: Ebû Saîd el-Hudrî (ra) anlatıyor: Bir adam: –Yâ Resûlallah, insanlardan hangisi daha üstündür, diye sordu.Resûlullah : –Canı ve malı ile Allah yolunda cihad eden mümin, dedi. –Sonra kimdir, deyince; –Dağ geçitlerinden bir geçite çekilip Rabbine ibadet edendir, buyurdu. Başka bir rivayet ise: Allah’tan korkan ve insanları kendi şerrinden uzak tutan mümindir, şeklindedir.
rawExcel.english_full_text: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The best of people is a man who is holding his horse's rein in the way of Allah (in Jihad) and is galloping towards the place wherever he hears a call for war or detects a note of danger; he goes on proceeding, seeking martyrdom or death wherever it is expected. And a man who retires with some sheep in a mountainside or a valley. He performs Salat regularly and pays the Zakat, continues worshipping his Rubb, till death overtakes him. He does not interfere in the affairs of the people except for betterment.".

en.clean: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do you know what is backbiting?" The Companions said: "Allah and His Messenger know better." Thereupon he said, "Backbiting is talking about your (Muslim) brother in a manner which he dislikes." It was said to him: "What if my (Muslim) brother is as I say." He said, "If he is actually as you say, then that is backbiting; but if that is not in him, that is slandering.".
