rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Ebû Bekir radıyallahu anh'tan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem, Vedâ haccında Minâ'da kurban günü verdiği hutbede şöyle buyurmuştur: "Şüphesiz kanlarınız, mallarınız ve ırzlarınız, bu gününüzün, bu ayınızdaki, bu beldenizdeki haramlığı gibi size haramdır. Dikkat edin, tebliğ ettim mi?"
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Abu Bakr, may Allah be pleased with him, reported that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said in his sermon on the Day of Sacrifice at Mina during the Farewell Pilgrimage: "Indeed, your blood, your wealth, and your honor are sacred to you, like the sacredness of this day of yours, in this month of yours, in this land of yours. Indeed, have I conveyed?"
rawExcel.sunnah.com_arabic_full_text: وعن أبي بكر رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال في خطبته يوم النحر بمنًى في حجة الوداع: "إن دماءكم، وأموالكم، وأعراضكم حرام عليكم كحرمة يومكم هذا، في شهركم هذا، في بلدكم هذا، ألا هل بلغت”
rawExcel.turkish_full_text: Ebû Bekre’den (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah Veda Haccı’nda, Mina’da bayram günü verdiği hutbede: Kanlarınız, mallarınız ve onurlarınız, tıpkı bu (Zilhicce) ayınızda, bu (Harem) beldenizde, bu (Arafat) gününüzün saygınlığı gibi birbirinize haramdır (saygındır, dokunulmazdır); tebliğ ettim mi, buyurdu.
rawExcel.english_full_text: Abu Bakrah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: Delivering the sermon during the Farewell Pilgrimage on the day of Sacrifice at Mina, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Verily your blood, your property and your honour are as sacred and inviolable as the sanctity of this day of yours, in this month of yours and in this town of yours. Verily! I have conveyed this message to you."

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Itbân b. Mâlik radıyallahu anh'ın daha önce recâ babında geçen meşhur uzun hadisinde şöyle denilmiştir: Nebî sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem namaza kalktı ve: "Mâlik b. ed-Duhşum nerede?" buyurdu. Bir adam: O münafıktır; Allah'ı ve Resûlü'nü sevmez, dedi. Nebî sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem: "Bunu söyleme! Onun Allah'ın yüzünü dileyerek 'Allah'tan başka ilâh yoktur' dediğini görmüyor musun? Allah, Allah'ın yüzünü dileyerek 'Allah'tan başka ilâh yoktur' diyen kimseyi ateşe haram kılmıştır" buyurdu. "Itbân" meşhur görüşe göre ayn harfi esreli okunur; onun üstünlü okunduğu da nakledilmiştir. Ardından üstten iki noktalı tâ, sonra tek noktalı bâ gelir. "ed-Duhşum" kelimesinde dâl ötreli, hâ ve şîn harfleri sakin ve ötrelidir; ikisi de noktalıdır.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: From Itban ibn Malik, may Allah be pleased with him, in his well-known long hadith that has previously appeared in the chapter on hope: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, stood to pray and said: "Where is Malik ibn al-Dukhshum?" A man said: He is a hypocrite; he does not love Allah and His Messenger. The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: "Do not say that. Do you not see that he has said: There is no god but Allah, seeking thereby the Face of Allah? Allah has forbidden the Fire for whoever says: There is no god but Allah, seeking thereby the Face of Allah." "Itban" is with kasrah on the ayn according to the well-known pronunciation, and dammah has also been reported; after it is a ta with two dots above, then a ba with one dot. "Al-Dukhshum" is with dammah on the dal, sukun on the kha, and dammah on the shin, both of the latter being dotted letters.

ar.clean: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "لا يحل لمؤمن أن يهجر مؤمنًا فوق ثلاث، فإن مرت به ثلاث، فليلقه، وليسلم عليه، فإن رد عليه السلام، فقد اشتركا في الأجر، وإن لم يرد عليه، فقد باء بالإثم، وخرج المسلم من الهجرة".

tr.clean: Ebû Hüreyre’den (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah şöyle buyurmuştur: Bir Müslümanın Müslüman kardeşine üç günden fazla küs durması helâl olmaz. Bir kimse üç günden fazla küs durur ve (bunda ısrar ederek) ölürse, cehenneme girer.

en.clean: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "It is not permissible for a believer to forsake his (Muslim) brother for more than three days. If three days have passed, he should meet him and greet him; and if other responds to it they will both share the reward; but if he does not respond, he will bear his sin and the one who (has taken the initiative to) greet (the other) will be absolved of the sin of forsaking (one's brother in Faith).".

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Ebû Hüreyre radıyallahu anh’tan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: “Bir müminin, bir mümini üç günden fazla terk edip onunla ilişkiyi kesmesi helâl değildir. Üç gün geçerse onunla karşılaşsın ve ona selâm versin. Eğer selâmını alırsa ikisi de ecirde ortak olur. Eğer selâmını almazsa günahı yüklenmiş olur; selâm veren ise küs kalma hâlinden çıkmış olur.”
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Abu Hurayrah, may Allah be pleased with him, reported that the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said: “It is not lawful for a believer to abandon a believer for more than three days. If three days have passed, let him meet him and greet him with salam. If he returns the salam, they both share in the reward. If he does not return it, he has borne the sin, and the one who gave the salam has come out of the state of abandonment.”

en.clean: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "In the presence of three people, two should not hold secret counsel, to the exclusion of the third.".In Abu Dawud, Abu Salih related: I asked Ibn 'Umar: "What if there are four people." He said, "There is no harm in that."Malik reported in Al-Muwatta that 'Abdullah bin Dinar related: Ibn 'Umar and I were together in Khalid bin 'Uqbah's house which was situated in the market place. A man came to consult Ibn 'Umar. None besides me was present. Ibn 'Umar called another man in and we became four and said to me and the man he had called: Move away a bit because I have heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "The two people should not hold secret counsel together excluding the third."

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: İbn Ömer radıyallahu anhümâ’dan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: “Üç kişi olduklarında, ikisi üçüncüyü dışlayarak gizli konuşmasın.” Ebû Dâvûd bunu rivayet etmiş ve şunu eklemiştir: Ebû Sâlih dedi ki: İbn Ömer’e, “Peki dört kişi olurlarsa?” dedim. O da: “Sana zarar vermez” dedi. Mâlik de el-Muvatta’da Abdullah b. Dînâr’dan şöyle rivayet etmiştir: Ben ve İbn Ömer çarşıdaki Hâlid b. Ukbe’nin evinin yanında bulunuyorduk. Bir adam gelip onunla gizli konuşmak istedi. İbn Ömer’in yanında benden başka kimse yoktu. Bunun üzerine İbn Ömer başka bir adam çağırdı; böylece dört kişi olduk. Bana ve çağırdığı üçüncü adama: “Biraz geri durun; çünkü ben Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’i şöyle buyururken işittim: ‘İki kişi, bir kişiyi dışlayarak gizli konuşmasın’” dedi.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Ibn Umar, may Allah be pleased with them both, reported that the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said: “When they are three, two should not converse privately to the exclusion of the third.” Abu Dawud narrated it and added: Abu Salih said: I said to Ibn Umar, “What about four?” He said: “That does not harm you.” Malik also narrated in al-Muwatta from Abdullah ibn Dinar: I and Ibn Umar were by the house of Khalid ibn Uqbah in the marketplace. A man came wanting to speak privately with him, and there was no one with Ibn Umar except me. So Ibn Umar called another man until we were four, and he said to me and to the third man whom he had called: “Move back a little, for I heard the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, say: ‘Two should not converse privately to the exclusion of one.’”

en.clean: 'Uqbah bin Al-Harith (May Allah be pleased with him) reported that he had married a daughter of Abu Ihab bin 'Aziz and a woman came to him and said she had suckled both 'Uqbah and the woman whom he had married, to which he replied: "I am not aware that you suckled me, and you did not inform me." So he ('Uqbah) rode to Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in Al-Madinah and put the matter before him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "How can you continue (to be her husband) after what you have been told?" 'Uqbah (May Allah be pleased with him) therefore divorced her and she married another man.

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Ebû Serva -sîn harfi esreli yahut üstün okunur- Ukbe b. Hâris radıyallahu anh'den rivayet edildiğine göre, o Ebû İhâb b. Azîz'in kızıyla evlenmişti. Bir kadın ona gelip: “Ben Ukbe'yi de evlendiği kadını da emzirdim” dedi. Ukbe ona: “Senin beni emzirdiğini bilmiyorum; bana da haber vermedin” dedi. Sonra Medine'ye, Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem'in yanına gidip meseleyi sordu. Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem: “Artık böyle denilmişken nasıl olur?” buyurdu. Bunun üzerine Ukbe ondan ayrıldı; kadın da başka bir erkekle evlendi.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: It is narrated from Abu Sarwa'—with the sin either kasrah or fatḥah—'Uqbah ibn al-Harith, may Allah be pleased with him, that he married the daughter of Abu Ihab ibn 'Aziz. A woman came to him and said: “I nursed 'Uqbah and the woman he married.” 'Uqbah said to her: “I do not know that you nursed me, and you did not inform me.” He rode to the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, in Madinah and asked him. The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “How can it be, when it has been said?” So 'Uqbah separated from her, and she married another husband.

items.text_ar: وعن أبى الدرداء رضي الله عنه: أن النبى صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: “ما من شئ أثقل في ميزان المؤمن يوم القيامة من حسن الخلق، وإن الله يبغض الفاحش البذي”
items.text_tr: Sa’b b. Cessâme (ra) şöyle demiştir: Ben Resûlullah’a (avladığım) bir yabani merkep hediye ettim; ancak kabul etmedi. Üzüldüğümü görünce de, “(Avını) ihramda olduğumuz için kabul edemedik.” diye açıklama yaptı.
items.text_en: Abud-Darda (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Nothing will be heavier on the Day of Resurrection in the Scale of the believer than good manners. Allah hates one who utters foul or coarse language.".

ar.clean: وعن جابر رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: “إن من أحبكم إلي، وأقربكم منى مجلساً يوم القيامة أحاسنكم أخلاقاً، وإن أبغضكم إلي وأبعدكم مني يوم القيامة، الثرثارون والمتشدقون والمتفيهقون” قالوا: يا رسول الله قد علمنا “الثرثارون والمتشدون” فما المتفيهقون؟ قال: “المتكبرون” "الثرثار": هو كثير الكلام تكلفاً. "والمتشدق": المتطاول على الناس بكلامه، ويتكلم بملء فيه تصافحاً وتعظيماً لكلامه؛ “والمتفيهق” :أصله من الفهق، وهو الامتلاء، وهو الذى يملأ فمه بالكلام، ويتوسع فيه ويغرب به تكبراً واتفاعاً، وإظهاراً للفضيلة على غيره. وروى الترمذي عن عبد الله بن المبارك رحمه الله في تفسير حسن الخلق قال: هو طلاقة الوجه، وبذل المعروف، وكف الأذى.

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Câbir radıyallahu anh’tan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: “Kıyamet günü bana en sevgili olanınız ve meclis bakımından bana en yakın bulunanınız, ahlâkı en güzel olanlarınızdır. Bana en sevimsiz olanınız ve kıyamet günü benden en uzak bulunanınız ise çok konuşanlar, sözleriyle büyüklenenler ve mütefeyhiklerdir.” Dediler ki: “Ey Allah’ın Resûlü! Çok konuşanları ve sözleriyle büyüklenenleri anladık; peki mütefeyhikler kimlerdir?” Buyurdu ki: “Kibirlenenlerdir.” “Sersâr”: zorlamayla çok konuşan kimsedir. “Müteşeddık”: sözüyle insanlara karşı üstünlük taslayan, ağzını doldura doldura süslü ve büyüklenici biçimde konuşan kimsedir. “Mütefeyhik”in aslı “fehk”ten gelir; doluluk demektir. Bu, ağzını sözle dolduran, konuşmada genişleyen ve kibirlenerek, yükselerek, başkalarına karşı üstünlük göstermeye çalışarak garip ifadeler kullanan kimsedir. Tirmizî, Abdullah b. Mübarek rahimehullah’tan güzel ahlâkın tefsiri olarak şunu rivayet etmiştir: “Güler yüzlü olmak, iyilikte bulunmak ve eziyeti engellemek.”
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: On the authority of Jābir, may Allah be pleased with him, that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “Among the most beloved of you to me and the nearest of you to me in sitting on the Day of Resurrection are those best in character. And among the most disliked of you to me and the farthest of you from me on the Day of Resurrection are the prattlers, the boastful speakers, and the mutafayhiqūn.” They said: “O Messenger of Allah, we know the prattlers and the boastful speakers; but who are the mutafayhiqūn?” He said: “The arrogant.” “Al-tharthār” is one who speaks much affectedly. “Al-mutashaddiq” is one who acts superior to people with his speech and speaks with his mouth full in affected eloquence and in magnification of his speech. “Al-mutafayhiq” derives from al-fahq, meaning fullness; it is one who fills his mouth with speech, expands in it, and uses unusual expressions out of arrogance, elevation, and display of superiority over others. Al-Tirmidhī narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mubārak, may Allah have mercy on him, in explanation of good character, that he said: It is a cheerful face, doing good, and withholding harm.

A woman is a shepherd in her husband’s house and is responsible for her flock. A servant is a shepherd over his master’s property and is responsible for his flock. Each of you is a shepherd, and each of you is responsible for his flock.”

en.clean: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: A drunkard was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ). He said, "Give him a beating." Then some beat him with their hands, some with their shoes, and some with (a folded) piece of cloth. When he left, someone said to him: "May Allah disgrace you!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not help Satan overcome him by uttering such words.".

en.clean: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited me after returning from a journey, and I had a shelf with a thin cloth curtain hanging over it and on which there were portraits. When he saw it, the colour of his face changed (because of anger) and he said, "O 'Aishah! the most grievous torment from Allah on the Day of Resurrection will be for those who imitate (Allah) in the act of His creation." 'Aishah said: We tore it into pieces and made a cushion or two cushions out of that.

Kıyamet günü Allah katında azabı en şiddetli olan insanlar, Allah’ın yaratmasına benzemeye çalışanlardır.’ Âişe dedi ki: Onu kestik ve ondan bir ya da iki yastık yaptık. ‘Kırâm’, kâf harfinin esreli okunmasıyla perde demektir. ‘Sahve’, sîn harfinin üstün okunmasıyla evin ön kısmında bulunan bölüm demektir; duvarda bulunan geçişli kemer/niş olduğu da söylenmiştir.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: ‘A’ishah, may Allah be pleased with her, said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, returned from a journey, and I had covered a sahwah of mine with a curtain that had images on it. When the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, saw it, his face changed color and he said: ‘O ‘A’ishah, the people most severely punished before Allah on the Day of Resurrection are those who imitate Allah’s creation.’ She said: So we cut it up and made from it one cushion or two. ‘Qiram,’ with kasrah on the qaf, means a curtain. ‘Sahwah,’ with fathah on the unpointed sin, is the projecting area in front of the house; it has also been said to be an opening or arch in the wall.
rawExcel.sunnah.com_arabic_full_text: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: قدم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من سفر وقد سترت سهوة لي بقرام فيه تماثيل فلما رآه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، تلون وجهه، وقال: "يا عائشة، أشد الناس عذابًا عن الله يوم القيامة الذين يضاهون بخلق الله" قالت: فقطعناه، فجعلنا منه وسادة أو وسادتين. «القِرامُ» بكسرِ القاف هو: السِّتْرُ. «وَالسَّهْوَةُ» بفتح السينِ المهملة وهي: الصُّفَّةُ تَكُونُ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ البَيْتِ، وقيلَ: هِيَ الطَّاقُ النَّافِذُ في الحائِطِ.
rawExcel.turkish_full_text: Urve’den (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre o, şöyle demiştir: Resûlullah’ın yanında uğursuzluktan bahsedilmişti. Bunun üzerine o, şöyle buyurdu: Bunun en iyisi “fe’l” yani hayra yormadır. Uğursuzluk, bir Müslümanı yapmak istediği bir şeyden vazgeçirmesin. Sizden biri, hoşuna gitmeyen bir şey gördüğünde “Allahümme lâ ye’tî bi’l-hasenâti illâ ente, velâ yedfeu’s-seyyiâti illâ ente, velâ havle velâ kuvvete illâ bik. (Allah’ım, iyilikleri yalnız sen verirsin, kötülükleri de ancak sen savarsın. Kuvvet ve kudret, yalnız senin yardımı nladır.)” diye dua etsin.
rawExcel.english_full_text: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited me after returning from a journey, and I had a shelf with a thin cloth curtain hanging over it and on which there were portraits. When he saw it, the colour of his face changed (because of anger) and he said, "O 'Aishah! the most grievous torment from Allah on the Day of Resurrection will be for those who imitate (Allah) in the act of His creation." 'Aishah said: We tore it into pieces and made a cushion or two cushions out of that.

en.clean: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: Jibril (Gabriel) (ﷺ) made a promise with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to come at a definite hour; that hour came but he did not visit him. There was a staff in the hand of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He threw it from his hand and said, "Never does Allah back out of His Promise, nor do His messengers." Then he noticed a puppy under his bed and said, "O 'Aishah, when did this dog enter?" She said: "By Allah, I don't know." He then commanded that it should be turned out. No sooner than had they expelled it, Jibril came and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him, "You promised to visit me. I waited for you but you did not come." Whereupon he said: "The dog kept me from coming. We do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a picture.".

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Âişe radıyallahu anhâ şöyle dedi: Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem, Cebrâil aleyhisselâm ile belli bir saatte gelmesi üzere sözleşti. O saat geldiği hâlde Cebrâil gelmedi. Âişe dedi ki: Elinde bir asa vardı; onu elinden bıraktı ve şöyle diyordu: ‘Allah da elçileri de vaadinden dönmez.’ Sonra baktı; yatağının altında bir köpek yavrusu vardı. ‘Bu köpek ne zaman girdi?’ buyurdu. Ben: Vallahi onu fark etmedim, dedim. Onun çıkarılmasını emretti; köpek çıkarıldı. Ardından Cebrâil aleyhisselâm geldi. Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem: ‘Bana söz vermiştin; senin için oturdum, fakat gelmedin’ buyurdu. Cebrâil: ‘Evinde bulunan köpek beni engelledi. Biz içinde köpek veya suret bulunan eve girmeyiz’ dedi.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: ‘A’ishah, may Allah be pleased with her, said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, had an appointment with Jibril, peace be upon him, at a certain hour that he would come to him. That hour came, but he did not come. She said: He had a stick in his hand, so he threw it from his hand and said: ‘Allah does not break His promise, nor do His messengers.’ Then he turned and saw a puppy under his bed. He said: ‘When did this dog enter?’ I said: By Allah, I did not know of it. He ordered it to be taken out, and it was taken out. Then Jibril, peace be upon him, came. The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: ‘You promised me, so I sat waiting for you, but you did not come.’ He said: The dog that was in your house prevented me; we do not enter a house in which there is a dog or an image.

He will say: Do you recognize such-and-such a sin? Do you recognize such-and-such a sin? He will say: My Lord, I recognize it. He will say: I concealed them for you in the world, and today I forgive them for you. Then he will be given the record of his good deeds." 'Kanaf' means His covering and mercy.

tr.clean: Ebû Hüreyre’den (ra) anlatıyor: Resûlullah şöyle buyurdu: İsrailoğulları peygamberler tarafından idare ediliyor; biri ölünce bir başka peygamber onun yerine geçiyordu. Benden sonra ise peygamber gelmeyecektir; halifeler olacak, sayıları çoğalacaktır. Sahâbîler: –Yâ Resûlallah, bu şartlarda bize ne tavsiye edersiniz, diye sorduklarında, Peygamber : –Öncelik sırasına göre onlara biat edin; onlara karşı yükümlülüklerinizi yerine getirin ve alamadığınız haklarınızı da Allah’tan isteyin. Zira Allah onlara, halka karşı görevlerini yapıp yapmadıklarını soracaktır, buyurdu.

ar.clean: وعن عبد الله بن عمرو رضي الله عنهما قال: كنا مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في سفر، فنزلنا منزلاً، فمنا من يصلح خباءه، ومنا من ينتضل، ومنا من هو في جشره، إذ نادى منادي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم الصلاة جامعة. فاجتمعنا إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال: “إنه لم يكن نبي قبلي إلا كان حقاً عليه أن يدل أمته على خير ما يعلمه لهم، وينذرهم شر ما يعلمه لهم، وإن أمتكم هذه جعل عاقبتها في أولها، وسيصيب آخرها بلاء وأمور تنكرونها، وتجئ فتن يرقق بعضها بعضاً، وتجئ الفتنة فيقول المؤمن : هذه مهلكتي، ثم تنكشف؛ وتجئ الفتنة فيقول المؤمن: هذه هذه، فمن أحب أن يزحزح عن النار، ويدخل الجنة، فلتأته منيته وهو يؤمن بالله واليوم الأخر، وليأت إلى الناس الذى يحب أن يؤتى إليه. ومن بايع إماماً فأعطاه صفقة يده، وثمرة قلبه، فليطعه إن استطاع، فإن جاء آخر ينازعه، فاضربوا عنق الآخر” . قوله: “ينتضل” أى : يسابق بالرمي بالنبل والنشاب. “والجشر” بفتح الجيم والشين المعجمة وبالراء: وهى الدواب التى ترعى وتبيت مكانها. وقوله: “يرقق بعضها بعضاً” أى: يصير بعضها بعضا رقيقاً، أى :خفيفاً لعظم ما بعده، فالثانى يرقق الأول. وقيل: معناه، يشوق بعضها إلى بعض بتحسينها وتسويليها، وقيل: يشبه بعضها بعضاً.

en.clean: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: We accompanied Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey. We halted at a place to take a rest. Some of us began to set right their tents, others began to graze their animals while others were engaged in competing with one another in archery when an announcer of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) announced that people should gather for Salat. We gathered around the Messenger of Allah and he ((ﷺ)) addressed us, saying, "Every Prophet before me was under obligation to guide his followers to what he knew was good for them and to warn the evil thing which he knew. As for this Ummah, it will have sound state and in its early stage of existence; but the last phase of its existence, will be faced with trials and with things you do not recognize. There will be tremendous trials, one after the other, and to each the believer will say, 'That is it'. Whenever a trial arrives the believer will say: 'This is going to bring about my destruction.' When this passes, another calamity will approach and he will say: 'This surely is going to be my end.' Whosoever wishes to be removed from the Fire (Hell) and admitted to Jannah should die with faith in Allah and the Last Day; and he should treat others as he wishes to be treated. He who swears allegiance to an Imam, he should give him the pledge in ratification and the sincerity of his heart. He should obey him to the best of his capacity. If another man comes forward as a claimant (when one has already been installed), behead the second.".

Kimimiz çadırını düzeltiyor, kimimiz ok atışında yarışıyor, kimimiz de hayvanlarının başında bulunuyordu. Derken Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’in münâdisi: “Namaz toplayıcıdır.” diye seslendi. Bunun üzerine Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’in yanında toplandık. Şöyle buyurdu: “Benden önce hiçbir peygamber yoktur ki, ümmeti için bildiği hayrı onlara göstermesi ve onlar için bildiği şerden onları sakındırması üzerine bir hak olmasın. Şu ümmetinizin afiyeti başlangıcında kılınmıştır; son kısmına ise belâlar ve hoş görmeyeceğiniz işler isabet edecektir. Fitneler gelecek, biri diğerini hafif gösterecektir. Fitne gelir, mümin: ‘Benim helâkim budur.’ der; sonra açılır gider. Sonra fitne gelir, mümin: ‘İşte bu, işte bu!’ der. Kim ateşten uzaklaştırılıp cennete girdirilmek isterse, ölümü kendisine Allah’a ve âhiret gününe iman etmiş olarak gelsin; insanlara da kendisine yapılmasını sevdiği şeyi yapsın. Kim bir imama biat eder, ona elinin anlaşmasını ve kalbinin meyvesini verirse, gücü yettiği ölçüde ona itaat etsin. Eğer başka biri gelip onunla yönetim konusunda çekişirse, sonrakinin boynunu vurun.” “Yentadil” sözü: ok ve yayla atışta yarışmak demektir. “Ceşer”, cim ve şın harflerinin üstün okunması ve sonunda râ ile, otlayan ve bulundukları yerde geceleyen hayvanlar demektir. “Biri diğerini hafif gösterir” sözü ise, sonrakinin büyüklüğü sebebiyle öncekinin hafif görünmesi, yani ikincinin birinciyi hafifletmesi demektir. Bir görüşe göre anlamı, birbirini süsleyip aldatıcı göstererek birini diğerine teşvik etmesidir. Bir görüşe göre de birbirine benzemesidir.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Abdullah ibn Amr (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: We were with the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) on a journey, and we stopped at a place. Some of us were repairing their tents, some were competing in archery, and some were with their grazing animals. Then the caller of the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) called: “The prayer is gathering.” We gathered to the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him), and he said: “There was no prophet before me except that it was his duty to guide his community to the good he knew for them and warn them against the evil he knew for them. The well-being of this community of yours has been placed in its beginning, while its latter part will be afflicted by trials and matters you will disapprove of. Trials will come, each making the other seem light. A trial will come and the believer will say: ‘This is my destruction,’ then it will pass. Then another trial will come and the believer will say: ‘This, this!’ Whoever wishes to be moved away from the Fire and admitted to Paradise, let his death come to him while he believes in Allah and the Last Day, and let him treat people as he would love to be treated. Whoever gives allegiance to an imam, giving him the clasp of his hand and the fruit of his heart, let him obey him if he is able. If another comes disputing with him, then strike the neck of the latter.” The phrase “yantadil” means competing in shooting with arrows and bows. “Al-jashar,” with fathah on the jim and shin and ending in ra, refers to livestock that graze and spend the night in their place. His saying “each making the other seem light” means that one makes another seem slight because of the greatness of what follows it; thus the second makes the first seem light. It has also been said that it means each incites toward the other by making it seem attractive and tempting; and it has been said that it means they resemble one another.
rawExcel.sunnah.com_arabic_full_text: وعن عبد الله بن عمرو رضي الله عنهما قال: كنا مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في سفر، فنزلنا منزلاً، فمنا من يصلح خباءه، ومنا من ينتضل، ومنا من هو في جشره، إذ نادى منادي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم الصلاة جامعة. فاجتمعنا إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال: “إنه لم يكن نبي قبلي إلا كان حقاً عليه أن يدل أمته على خير ما يعلمه لهم، وينذرهم شر ما يعلمه لهم، وإن أمتكم هذه جعل عاقبتها في أولها، وسيصيب آخرها بلاء وأمور تنكرونها، وتجئ فتن يرقق بعضها بعضاً، وتجئ الفتنة فيقول المؤمن : هذه مهلكتي، ثم تنكشف؛ وتجئ الفتنة فيقول المؤمن: هذه هذه، فمن أحب أن يزحزح عن النار، ويدخل الجنة، فلتأته منيته وهو يؤمن بالله واليوم الأخر، وليأت إلى الناس الذى يحب أن يؤتى إليه. ومن بايع إماماً فأعطاه صفقة يده، وثمرة قلبه، فليطعه إن استطاع، فإن جاء آخر ينازعه، فاضربوا عنق الآخر” . قوله: “ينتضل” أى : يسابق بالرمي بالنبل والنشاب. “والجشر” بفتح الجيم والشين المعجمة وبالراء: وهى الدواب التى ترعى وتبيت مكانها. وقوله: “يرقق بعضها بعضاً” أى: يصير بعضها بعضا رقيقاً، أى :خفيفاً لعظم ما بعده، فالثانى يرقق الأول. وقيل: معناه، يشوق بعضها إلى بعض بتحسينها وتسويليها، وقيل: يشبه بعضها بعضاً.
rawExcel.turkish_full_text: İbn Ömer (ra) şöyle demiştir: Biz “dinlemek ve itaat etmek üzere” biat ettiğimizde, Resûlullah , “gücünüz yettiği kadar” kaydını ilave ederdi.
rawExcel.english_full_text: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: We accompanied Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey. We halted at a place to take a rest. Some of us began to set right their tents, others began to graze their animals while others were engaged in competing with one another in archery when an announcer of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) announced that people should gather for Salat. We gathered around the Messenger of Allah and he ((ﷺ)) addressed us, saying, "Every Prophet before me was under obligation to guide his followers to what he knew was good for them and to warn the evil thing which he knew. As for this Ummah, it will have sound state and in its early stage of existence; but the last phase of its existence, will be faced with trials and with things you do not recognize. There will be tremendous trials, one after the other, and to each the believer will say, 'That is it'. Whenever a trial arrives the believer will say: 'This is going to bring about my destruction.' When this passes, another calamity will approach and he will say: 'This surely is going to be my end.' Whosoever wishes to be removed from the Fire (Hell) and admitted to Jannah should die with faith in Allah and the Last Day; and he should treat others as he wishes to be treated. He who swears allegiance to an Imam, he should give him the pledge in ratification and the sincerity of his heart. He should obey him to the best of his capacity. If another man comes forward as a claimant (when one has already been installed), behead the second.".

en.clean: Abu Qatadah Al-Harith bin Rib'i (May Allah bepleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Faith in Allah and striving in His Cause (Jihad) are the deeds of highest merit." A man stood up said: "O Messenger of Allah! Tell me if I am killed in the Cause of Allah, will all my sins be forgiven?" He (ﷺ) replied, "Yes, if you are killed in the Cause of Allah while you are patient, hopeful of your reward and marching forward not retreating." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Repeat what you have said." The man said: "Tell me if I am killed in the Cause of Allah, will all my sins be remitted?". He replied, "Yes, if you are martyred while you are patient, hopeful of your reward and march forward without retreating, unless, if you owe any debt, that will not be remitted. Angel Jibril told me that".

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Ebû Katâde el-Hâris b. Rib‘î (r.a.) rivayet etti: Resûlullah (s.a.v.) onların arasında ayağa kalktı ve Allah yolunda cihad ile Allah’a imanın amellerin en faziletlisi olduğunu anlattı. Bir adam kalkıp: ‘Ey Allah’ın Resûlü, Allah yolunda öldürülürsem günahlarım bağışlanır mı?’ dedi. Resûlullah (s.a.v.): ‘Evet; sabrederek, sevabını Allah’tan bekleyerek, ileri gidip geri dönmeden Allah yolunda öldürülürsen’ buyurdu. Sonra Resûlullah (s.a.v.): ‘Nasıl demiştin?’ dedi. Adam sorusunu tekrarladı. Bunun üzerine: ‘Evet; sabrederek, sevabını Allah’tan bekleyerek, ileri gidip geri dönmeden; ancak borç hariç. Cebrâil bana bunu söyledi’ buyurdu.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Abu Qatadah al-Harith ibn Rib‘i (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) stood among them and mentioned that striving in the way of Allah and faith in Allah are the best of deeds. A man stood and said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, if I am killed in the way of Allah, will my sins be expiated?’ The Messenger of Allah said: ‘Yes, if you are killed in the way of Allah while patient, seeking reward, advancing and not retreating.’ Then the Messenger of Allah said: ‘What did you say?’ The man repeated his question. He said: ‘Yes—while patient, seeking reward, advancing and not retreating—except for debt, for Gabriel told me that.’

ar.clean: الخامس: عن أبي عبد الله النعمان بن بشير رضي الله عنهما، قال: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: "لتسون صفوفكم أو ليخالفن الله بين وجوهكم " وفي رواية لمسلم: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يسوي صفوفنا حتى كأنما يسوي بها القداح ،حتى إذا رأى أنا قد عقلنا عنه ثم خرج يوما، فقام حتى كاد أن يكبر، فرأى رجلاً بادياً صدره فقال: " عباد الله لتسون صفوفكم أو ليخالفن الله بين وجوهكم".

tr.clean: Ebû Abdullah Numân b. Beşîr (ra) Resûlullah’ın şöyle dediğini işittiğini nakletmiştir: Ya saflarınızı düzeltirsiniz ya da Allah aranıza ayrılık verir de birbirinizden yüz çevirirsiniz. (B717 Buhârî, Ezân, 71; M978 Müslim, Salât, 127) Müslim’in bir rivayeti de şöyledir: Resûlullah âdeta okları düzeltir gibi saflarımızı düzeltirdi. Biz alışıncaya kadar böyle yapmaya devam etti. Sonra bir gün Peygamber geldi ve namaz kılacağı yerde durdu. Tam tekbir alacağı sırada göğsü saftan ileri çıkmış bir adam gördü, bunun üzerine: –Ey Allah’ın kulları, ya saflarınızı düzeltirsiniz ya da Allah aranıza ayrılık verir de birbirinizden yüz çevirirsiniz, buyurdu.

en.clean: Nu'man bin Bashir (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Straighten your rows (during Salat) or Allah would create dissension amongst you".In another narration reported by Muslim, Nu'man bin Bashir (May Allah be pleased with them) narrated: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to straighten our rows (in Salat), as if he was straightening an arrow with their help until he saw that we had learnt it from him. One day he came out, stood up (for Salat) and was about to say: Allahu Akbar (Allah is the Greatest), (marking the beginning of the prayer) when he saw a man, whose chest was bulging out from the row. He said, "Slaves of Allah, you must straighten your rows or Allah would create dissension amongst you."

Beşîr’den (radıyallahu anhümâ) rivayet edildiğine göre şöyle dedi: Resûlullah’ın (sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem) şöyle buyurduğunu işittim: “Saflarınızı mutlaka düzeltin; aksi hâlde Allah yüzlerinizi/kalplerinizi birbirine muhalif kılar.” Müslim’in bir rivayetinde: Resûlullah (sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem) saflarımızı, sanki okları düzeltiyormuş gibi düzeltirdi. Bizim bunu kendisinden iyice anladığımızı görünce bir gün çıktı, namaza durdu ve neredeyse tekbir alacaktı ki göğsü safın dışına çıkmış bir adam gördü. Bunun üzerine şöyle buyurdu: “Ey Allah’ın kulları! Saflarınızı mutlaka düzeltin; yoksa Allah yüzlerinizi/kalplerinizi birbirine muhalif kılar.”
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Al-Nu‘man ibn Bashir (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) say: “You must straighten your rows, or Allah will surely cause discord among your faces/hearts.” In a narration of Muslim: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) used to straighten our rows as though he were straightening arrows. When he saw that we had understood this from him, he came out one day, stood to pray, and was about to pronounce the takbir when he saw a man whose chest was protruding from the row. He said: “Servants of Allah, you must straighten your rows, or Allah will surely cause discord among your faces/hearts.”
rawExcel.sunnah.com_arabic_full_text: الخامس: عن أبي عبد الله النعمان بن بشير رضي الله عنهما، قال: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: "لتسون صفوفكم أو ليخالفن الله بين وجوهكم " وفي رواية لمسلم: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يسوي صفوفنا حتى كأنما يسوي بها القداح ،حتى إذا رأى أنا قد عقلنا عنه ثم خرج يوما، فقام حتى كاد أن يكبر، فرأى رجلاً بادياً صدره فقال: " عباد الله لتسون صفوفكم أو ليخالفن الله بين وجوهكم".
rawExcel.turkish_full_text: Ebû Abdullah Numân b. Beşîr (ra) Resûlullah’ın şöyle dediğini işittiğini nakletmiştir: Ya saflarınızı düzeltirsiniz ya da Allah aranıza ayrılık verir de birbirinizden yüz çevirirsiniz. (B717 Buhârî, Ezân, 71; M978 Müslim, Salât, 127) Müslim’in bir rivayeti de şöyledir: Resûlullah âdeta okları düzeltir gibi saflarımızı düzeltirdi. Biz alışıncaya kadar böyle yapmaya devam etti. Sonra bir gün Peygamber geldi ve namaz kılacağı yerde durdu. Tam tekbir alacağı sırada göğsü saftan ileri çıkmış bir adam gördü, bunun üzerine: –Ey Allah’ın kulları, ya saflarınızı düzeltirsiniz ya da Allah aranıza ayrılık verir de birbirinizden yüz çevirirsiniz, buyurdu.
rawExcel.english_full_text: Nu'man bin Bashir (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Straighten your rows (during Salat) or Allah would create dissension amongst you".In another narration reported by Muslim, Nu'man bin Bashir (May Allah be pleased with them) narrated: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to straighten our rows (in Salat), as if he was straightening an arrow with their help until he saw that we had learnt it from him. One day he came out, stood up (for Salat) and was about to say: Allahu Akbar (Allah is the Greatest), (marking the beginning of the prayer) when he saw a man, whose chest was bulging out from the row. He said, "Slaves of Allah, you must straighten your rows or Allah would create dissension amongst you."

en.clean: Wa'il bin Hujr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Salamah bin Yazid Al-Ju'f (May Allah be pleased with him) asked Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): "O Prophet of Allah! Tell us, what you command us to do if there arises over us rulers who demand of us what is due to them and refuse us what is due to us." Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) turned away from him, but he repeated the same question. Thereupon Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Listen to them and obey them. They are responsible for their obligations and you are accountable for yours.".

Üzerimize, bizden kendi haklarını isteyen fakat bizim hakkımızı vermeyen emirler yönetici olursa, bize ne emredersiniz?” Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem ondan yüz çevirdi. Sonra yine sordu. Bunun üzerine Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem buyurdu ki: “Dinleyin ve itaat edin. Onlara yükletilen kendilerine, size yükletilen de sizedir.”
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Abu Hunaydah Wa’il ibn Hujr (may Allah be pleased with him) said: Salamah ibn Yazid al-Ju‘fi asked the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him): “O Prophet of Allah, what do you think if rulers are appointed over us who ask us for their rights but withhold our rights; what do you command us to do?” He turned away from him. Then he asked him again. The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “Listen and obey. They are responsible only for what they have been charged with, and you are responsible for what you have been charged with.”
rawExcel.sunnah.com_arabic_full_text: وعن أبى هنيدة وائل بن حجر رضي الله عنه قال: سأل سلمة بن يزيد الجعفي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فقال: يا نبي الله، أرأيت إن قامت علينا امراء يسألونا حقهم، ويمنعونا حقنا، فما تأمرنا؟ فأعرض عنه، ثم سأله، فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم “اسمعوا وأطيعو؛ فإنما عليهما حملوا، وعليكم ماحملتم”
rawExcel.turkish_full_text: İbn Ömer’in (ra) işittiğine göre Resûlullah şöyle buyurmuştur: Bir kimse (meşru bir sebep olmaksızın) yöneticilere itaattan vazgeçerse, kıyamet gününde, Allah’ın huzuruna dayanacağı bir delili olmaksızın çıkar. Biatsız ölen bir kimse de, Câhiliye ölümü ile ölür. (M4793 Müslim, İmâre, 58) Müslim’in diğer bir rivayeti de: Müslüman topluluktan ayrılmış olarak ölen kimse, Câhiliye ölümü ile ölür, şeklindedir.
rawExcel.english_full_text: Wa'il bin Hujr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Salamah bin Yazid Al-Ju'f (May Allah be pleased with him) asked Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): "O Prophet of Allah! Tell us, what you command us to do if there arises over us rulers who demand of us what is due to them and refuse us what is due to us." Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) turned away from him, but he repeated the same question. Thereupon Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Listen to them and obey them. They are responsible for their obligations and you are accountable for yours.".

Peygamber şöyle demiştir: –Bir Müslüman, (hasta bir) Müslüman kardeşini ziyaret ettiğinde, ziyaretini tamamlayıp geri dönünceye kadar ,(sanki) cennet hurfesi topluyormuş gibi olur. –Yâ Resûlallah, “cennet hurfesi” nedir, denilince; –Zamanı geldiğinde ağaçtan toplanan meyvedir, cevabını vermiştir.
items.text_en: Thauban (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who visits his brother in Faith, will remain engaged in picking the fresh fruits from the garden of Jannah till he returns.".

en.clean: Talhah bin 'Ubaidullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: A person with dishevelled hair, one of the people of Najd, came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). We heard the humming of his voice but could not fully understand what he was saying, till he approached close to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Then I came to know that he was asking about Islam. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "There are five (obligatory) Salat during the day and the night." He said: "Am I obliged to perform any other (Salat) besides these?" The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "No, but whatever you observe voluntarily." He (ﷺ) added, "There is the Saum of Ramadan." The inquirer asked: "Am I obliged to do anything besides this?" The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "No, but whatever you do out of your own free will. You may observe voluntary fasting." And the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) told him about the Zakat (obligatory charity). The inquirer asked: "Am I obliged to pay anything besides this?" The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "No, but whatever you pay voluntarily out of your own free will." That man turned back saying: "By Allah! I will neither make any addition to this nor will I decrease anything from it." (Upon hearing this) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remarked, "He is successful if he proves truthful (to what he is saying).".

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Talha b. Ubeydullah radıyallahu anh'dan rivayet edildiğine göre şöyle dedi: Necid halkından saçı dağınık bir adam Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem'e geldi. Sesinin uğultusunu işitiyor, fakat ne söylediğini anlamıyorduk. Nihayet Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem'e yaklaştı; bir de baktık ki İslâm hakkında soruyordu. Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: "Bir gün ve gecede beş vakit namaz." Adam, "Bunların dışında üzerime bir şey var mı?" dedi. O, "Hayır; ancak nafile olarak yaparsan başka" buyurdu. Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: "Ramazan ayının orucu." Adam, "Onun dışında üzerime bir şey var mı?" dedi. O, "Hayır; ancak nafile olarak yaparsan başka" buyurdu. Sonra Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem ona zekâtı anlattı. Adam, "Bunun dışında üzerime bir şey var mı?" dedi. O, "Hayır; ancak nafile olarak yaparsan başka" buyurdu. Adam dönüp giderken, "Vallahi buna ne bir şey ekleyeceğim ne de ondan eksilteceğim" diyordu. Bunun üzerine Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem, "Eğer doğru söylediyse kurtuluşa erdi" buyurdu.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: It is narrated from Talhah ibn Ubaydullah, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: A man from the people of Najd came to the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, with disheveled hair. We could hear the murmur of his voice, but we did not understand what he was saying, until he drew near to the Messenger of Allah. It turned out that he was asking about Islam. The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: "Five prayers in the day and night." He said: "Is anything else required of me besides them?" He said: "No, unless you do so voluntarily." The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, then said: "And fasting the month of Ramadan." He said: "Is anything else required of me besides it?" He said: "No, unless you do so voluntarily." The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, also mentioned zakah to him. He said: "Is anything else required of me besides it?" He said: "No, unless you do so voluntarily." The man turned away saying: "By Allah, I will neither add to this nor diminish from it." The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: "He will succeed if he is truthful."

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Ebû Hüreyre’den (Allah ondan razı olsun) rivayet edildiğine göre şöyle dedi: Resûlullah (sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem) şöyle buyurdu: “Kim darda olana mühlet verir veya onun borcunu indirirse, Allah kıyamet gününde, kendi gölgesinden başka hiçbir gölgenin bulunmadığı günde onu Arş’ının gölgesi altında gölgelendirir.”
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: From Abū Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him), who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: “Whoever gives respite to one in difficulty or remits something for him, Allah will shade him on the Day of Resurrection beneath the shade of His Throne, on a day when there is no shade but His shade.”
rawExcel.sunnah.com_arabic_full_text: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "من أنظر معسرًا أو وضع له، أظله الله يوم القيامة تحت ظل عرشه يوم لا ظل إلا ظله".
rawExcel.turkish_full_text: Ebû Hüreyre’den (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah şöyle demiştir: Kim darda olan birine borcunu ödeme konusunda mühlet verir veya onun borcunu silerse, Allah, kendisininkinden başka hiçbir gölgenin (himayenin) olmadığı kıyamet gününde onu arşının gölgesinde gölgelendirir (yani onu himaye eder).
rawExcel.english_full_text: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who gives respite to someone who is in straitened circumstances, or grants him remission, Allah will shelter him in the shade of His Throne, on the Day of Resurrection, when there will be no shade except its shade.".

tr.clean: Ebû Zer’den (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Peygamber şöyle buyurmuştur: Ümmetimin iyi ve kötü bütün amelleri bana arz olundu. İyi amellerin içinde, insanlara sıkıntı verecek şeylerin yoldan kaldırılmasını da gördüm. rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Ebû Saîd el-Hasen el-Basrî’den rivayet edildiğine göre Âiz b. Amr (radıyallahu anh), Ubeydullah b. Ziyâd’ın yanına girdi ve şöyle dedi: “Yavrucuğum! Resûlullah’ın (sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem) şöyle buyurduğunu işittim: ‘Çobanların/yöneticilerin en kötüsü, sertlik ve zulümle sürüyü kırıp geçiren kimsedir.’ Onlardan olmaktan sakın.” Ubeydullah ona, “Otur! Sen Muhammed’in (sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem) ashabının döküntülerindensin” dedi. Âiz şöyle cevap verdi: “Onların içinde döküntü mü vardı? Döküntü ancak onlardan sonra ve onların dışındakiler arasında ortaya çıktı.”
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Abu Sa‘id al-Hasan al-Basri reported that ‘A’idh ibn ‘Amr (may Allah be pleased with him) entered upon ‘Ubayd Allah ibn Ziyad and said: “My son, I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) say: ‘The worst of shepherds/rulers are the harsh ones who crush their flock.’ Beware of being among them.” He said to him: “Sit down; you are only from the refuse of the Companions of Muhammad.” He replied: “Was there any refuse among them? Refuse only appeared after them and among others.”

en.clean: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has written the very portion of Zina which a man will indulge in. There will be no escape from it. The Zina of the eye is the (lustful) look, the Zina of the ears is the listening (to voluptuous songs or talk), the Zina of the tongue is (the licentious) speech, the Zina of the hand is the (lustful) grip, the Zina of the feet is the walking (to the place where he intends to commit Zina), the heart yearns and desires and the private parts approve all that or disapprove it.".This is the wording in Muslim; Al-Bukhari wording is a bit short.

Gözlerin zinası bakmaktır; kulakların zinası dinlemektir; dilin zinası konuşmaktır; elin zinası tutmaktır; ayağın zinası adım atmaktır. Kalp arzu eder ve temenni eder; cinsel organ ise bunu ya doğrular ya da yalanlar.”
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Abu Hurayrah, may Allah be pleased with him, reported that the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said: “The share of zina has been written for the son of Adam, and he will inevitably reach that. The zina of the eyes is looking; the zina of the ears is listening; the zina of the tongue is speech; the zina of the hand is touching; the zina of the foot is walking. The heart desires and wishes, and the private part either confirms that or denies it.”

rawExcel.english_full_text: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has written the very portion of Zina which a man will indulge in. en.clean: Hudhaifah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I performed Salat with the Prophet (ﷺ) one night, and he started reciting Surat Al- Baqarah. I thought that he would go in Ruku' (bowing posture in Salat) at the end of one hundred Ayat, but he continued (reciting); and I thought that he would perhaps recite (this Surah) in the whole Rak'ah (prayer), but he continued the recitation; I thought he would perhaps bow on completing (this Surah). He (ﷺ) then started reciting Surat An-Nisa' which he followed with Surat Al-Imran. He recited leisurely. When he recited an Ayah which mentioned the tasbeeh, he would say Subhan Allah and when he recited the Ayah which tells how the Rubb is to be asked, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would then ask from Him; and when he (ﷺ) recited an Ayah asking one to seek Protection Allah, he would seek Protection of Allah. Then he bowed and said, "Subhana Rabbiyal-Azim (My Rubb the Great is free from imperfection)"; his bowing lasted about the same length of time as his standing, (and then on returning to the standing posture after Ruku') he would say, "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah, Rabbana lakal-hamd (Allah listens to him who praises Him. Praise be to You, Our Rubb!)," and he would then stand about the same length of time as he had spent in bowing. He would then prostrate himself and say, "Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la (My Rubb the Supreme is free from imperfection)," and his prostration lasted nearly the same length of time as his standing (Qiyam).
en.sourceText: Hudhaifah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I performed Salat with the Prophet (ﷺ) one night, and he started reciting Surat Al- Baqarah. I thought that he would go in Ruku' (bowing posture in Salat) at the end of one hundred Ayat, but he continued (reciting); and I thought that he would perhaps recite (this Surah) in the whole Rak'ah (prayer), but he continued the recitation; I thought he would perhaps bow on completing (this Surah). He (ﷺ) then started reciting Surat An-Nisa' which he followed with Surat Al-Imran. He recited leisurely. When he recited an Ayah which mentioned the tasbeeh, he would say Subhan Allah and when he recited the Ayah which tells how the Rubb is to be asked, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would then ask from Him; and when he (ﷺ) recited an Ayah asking one to seek Protection Allah, he would seek Protection of Allah. Then he bowed and said, "Subhana Rabbiyal-Azim (My Rubb the Great is free from imperfection)"; his bowing lasted about the same length of time as his standing, (and then on returning to the standing posture after Ruku') he would say, "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah, Rabbana lakal-hamd (Allah listens to him who praises Him. Praise be to You, Our Rubb!)," and he would then stand about the same length of time as he had spent in bowing. He would then prostrate himself and say, "Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la (My Rubb the Supreme is free from imperfection)," and his prostration lasted nearly the same length of time as his standing (Qiyam).

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Huzeyfe radıyallahu anh şöyle dedi: Bir gece Nebî sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem ile birlikte namaz kıldım. Bakara sûresine başladı. “Yüz âyette rükû eder.” dedim; sonra devam etti. “Onu bir rek‘atta kılacak.” dedim; yine devam etti. “Onunla rükû eder.” dedim. Sonra Nisâ sûresine başladı ve onu okudu; ardından Âl-i İmrân sûresine başladı ve onu okudu. Tertîl üzere okuyordu. Tesbih bulunan bir âyete uğradığında tesbih eder, isteme bulunan bir âyete uğradığında ister, sığınma bulunan bir âyete uğradığında sığınırdı. Sonra rükû etti ve: “Sübhâne rabbiye’l-azîm” demeye başladı; rükûsu kıyamına yakın uzunluktaydı. Sonra: “Semiallahu limen hamideh, rabbenâ leke’l-hamd” dedi. Ardından uzun süre ayakta durdu; bu, rükûsuna yakın bir süreydi. Sonra secde etti ve: “Sübhâne rabbiye’l-a‘lâ” dedi; secdesi de kıyamına yakın uzunluktaydı.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Hudhayfah, may Allah be pleased with him, said: I prayed with the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, one night. He began with al-Baqarah. I said: “He will bow at one hundred verses,” but he continued. I said: “He will pray it in one rak‘ah,” but he continued. I said: “He will bow with it,” then he began al-Nisa’ and recited it, then began Al ‘Imran and recited it. He recited deliberately. When he passed a verse containing glorification, he glorified; when he passed a verse containing a request, he asked; and when he passed a verse containing seeking refuge, he sought refuge. Then he bowed and began saying: “Subhana Rabbiya al-‘Azim,” and his bowing was about as long as his standing. Then he said: “Sami‘a Allahu liman hamidah, Rabbana laka al-hamd.” Then he stood for a long time, nearly as long as he had bowed. Then he prostrated and said: “Subhana Rabbiya al-A‘la,” and his prostration was close in length to his standing.
rawExcel.sunnah.com_arabic_full_text: وعن حذيفة رضي الله عنه، قال: صليت مع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ، ذات ليلة فافتتح البقرة، فقلت: يركع عند المائة، ثم مضى، فقلت: يصلي بها في ركعة، فمضي، فقلت: يركع بها، ثم افتتح النساء فقرأها، ثم افتتح آل عمران، فقرأها، يقرأ مترسلا. إذا مر بآية فيها تسبيح سبح، وإذا بسؤال سأل، وإذا مر بتعوذ تعوذ، ثم ركع، فجعل يقول: سبحان ربي العظيم، فكان ركوعه نحوًا من قيامه، ثم قال: سمع الله لمن حمده، ربنا لك الحمد، ثم قام طويلا قريبًا مما ركع، ثم سجد فقال: سبحان ربي الأعلى، فكان سجوده قريبًا من قيامه.
rawExcel.turkish_full_text: İbn Mes’ûd’dan (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre o, şöyle demiştir: Bir gece Peygamber ile namaz kıldım. Kıyamı o kadar uzattı ki, içimden kötü bir şey yapmak geldi. –Ne yapmayı geçirdin içinden, diye sordular. –İçimden Peygamber’i (kıyamda) bırakıp, oturmayı geçirdim.

Kim Allah’ı anmadığı bir yatakta uzanırsa, onun için Allah katından bir eksiklik ve sorumluluk olur.” Ebû Dâvûd rivayet etmiştir. Bu hadis az önce geçmiş ve orada “tire” kelimesini açıklamıştık.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: It is narrated from him, from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), that he said: “Whoever sits in a place in which he does not remember Allah Most High, there will be upon him from Allah a deficiency and liability; and whoever lies down in a resting place in which he does not remember Allah, there will be upon him from Allah a deficiency and liability.” Abū Dāwūd narrated it. It has already been mentioned shortly before, and we explained “tirah” there.

en.clean: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: A poor woman came to me carrying her two daughters. I gave her three date-fruits. She gave a date to each of them and then she took up one date-fruit and brought that to her mouth to eat, but her daughters asked her that also. She then divided between them the date-fruit that she intended to eat. This (kind) treatment of her impressed me and I mentioned that to Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) who said, 'Verily, Allah has assured Jannah for her, because of (this act) of her," or said, "He (SWT) has rescued her from Hell- Fire".

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Âişe radıyallahu anhâ şöyle dedi: İki kızını taşıyan yoksul bir kadın bana geldi. Ona üç hurma verdim. Her bir kızına birer hurma verdi; bir hurmayı da yemek için ağzına götürdü. Kızları onu da istediler. Kadın yemek istediği hurmayı ikiye bölerek onların arasında paylaştırdı. Bu davranışı hoşuma gitti; yaptığını Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’e anlattım. Bunun üzerine şöyle buyurdu: “Allah bu davranışı sebebiyle ona cenneti vacip kılmıştır” yahut “bu davranışı sebebiyle onu cehennemden azat etmiştir.”
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: ‘A’ishah, may Allah be pleased with her, said: A poor woman came to me carrying her two daughters, so I fed her three dates. She gave each daughter a date and lifted a date to her mouth to eat it. Her two daughters asked her for it, so she split the date she had intended to eat between them. I was impressed by what she did, and I mentioned it to the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him. He said: “Allah has made Paradise obligatory for her because of it,” or, “He has freed her from the Fire because of it.”

This (kind) treatment of her impressed me and I mentioned that to Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) who said, 'Verily, Allah has assured Jannah for her, because of (this act) of her," or said, "He (SWT) has rescued her from Hell- Fire".

tr.clean: İbn Abbâs’tan (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah şöyle dua ederlerdi: “Allah’ım, sana teslim oldum, sana iman ettim, sana güvendim, sana yöneldim. Senin yardımınla düşmana karşı koydum, senin hükmünle hükmettim. Yâ Rabbi, yaptığım ve yapacağım, gizlediğim ve açığa vurduğum günahlarımı bağışla. Öne geçiren de, geri bırakan da sensin. Senden başka ilah yoktur.” Ravilerden bazıları “Lâ havle ve lâ kuvvete illâ billâh” cümlesini de eklemiştir.

en.clean: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to supplicate: "Allahumma laka aslamtu, wa bika amantu, wa 'alaika tawakkaltu, wa ilaika anabtu, wa bika khasamtu, wa ilaika hakamtu. Faghfir li ma qaddamtu, wa ma akh-khartu, wa ma asrartu wa ma a'lantu, Antal-Muqaddimu, wa Antal-Mu'akhkhiru, la ilaha illa Anta (O Allah! to You I submit, in You I affirm my faith, in You I repose my trust, to You I turn in repentance and with Your Help I contend my adversaries and from You I seek judgement. O Allah! Grant me forgiveness for the faults which I made in past and those ones I may commit in the future, those which I committed secretly or openly. You Alone send whomever You will to Jannah, and You Alone send whomever You will to Hell-fire. There is none worthy of worship except You)." Another narration adds: "La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah (There is no strength to resist evil and no power to do good except through Allah).".

rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: From Ibn ‘Abbas, may Allah be pleased with them both, it is narrated that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, used to say: “O Allah, to You I have submitted, in You I have believed, upon You I have relied, to You I have turned, by You I have argued, and to You I have referred judgment. So forgive me what I have sent ahead, what I have delayed, what I have concealed, and what I have made public. You are the One who brings forward, and You are the One who puts back. There is no deity except You.” Some narrators added: “There is no power and no strength except through Allah.”

en.clean: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about the deed which will be foremost to lead a man to Jannah. He replied, "Fear of Allah and the good conduct." Then he was asked about indulgence which will admit a man to Hell (Fire) and he answered, "The tongue and the genitals.".

en.clean: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Seven are (the persons) whom Allah will give Shade of His Thrown on the Day when there would be no shade other than His Throne's Shade: A just ruler; a youth who grew up worshipping Allah; a man whose heart is attached to mosques; two persons who love and meet each other and depart from each other for the sake of Allah; a man whom an extremely beautiful woman seduces (for illicit relation), but he (rejects this offer by saying): 'I fear Allah'; a man who gives in charity and conceals it (to such an extent) that the left hand does not know what the right has given; and a person who remembers Allah in solitude and his eyes well up".

ar.clean: وعن أبي برزة نضلة بن عبيد الأسلمي رضي الله عنه قال بينما جارية على ناقة عليها بعض متاع القوم، إذ بصرت بالنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، وتضايق بهم الجبل، فقالت: حل، اللهم العنها. فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : "لا تصاحبنا ناقة عليها لعنة" قوله: حل بفتح الحاء المهملة، وإسكان اللام وهي كلمة لزجر الإبل واعلم أن هذا الحديث قد يستشكل معناه ولا إشكال فيه بل المراد النهي أن تصاحبهم تلك الناقة وليس فيه نهي عن بيعها وذبحها وركوبها في غير صحبة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بل كل ذلك وما سواه من التصرفات جائز لا منع منه إلا من مصاحبته صلى الله عليه وسلم بها لأن هذه التصرفات كلها كانت جائزة فمنع بعض منها فبقي الباقي على ما كان والله أعلم

en.clean: Abu Barzah Nadlah bin 'Ubaid Al-Aslami (May Allah be pleased with him) said: A young woman was riding a she-camel on which there was the luggage of people. Suddenly she saw the Prophet (ﷺ). The pass of the mountain became narrow for her people (because of fear). The young woman said to the she-camel: "Go ahead." When it did not move, she said, "O Allah! Curse it." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The she-camel that has been cursed should not accompany us.".

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Ebû Berze Nadle b. Ubeyd el-Eslemî radıyallahu anh şöyle dedi: Bir cariye, üzerinde kavmin bazı eşyaları bulunan bir devenin üzerindeydi. Derken Nebî sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’i gördü; dağ yolu onlara dar gelmişti. Cariye: “Hal! Allah’ım, ona lanet et!” dedi. Nebî sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem: “Üzerinde lanet bulunan bir deve bizimle arkadaşlık etmesin” buyurdu. “Hal” kelimesi, hâ harfi üstünlü ve lâm sâkin olarak okunur; develeri yürütmek veya azarlamak için kullanılan bir sözdür. Bil ki bu hadisin anlamı problemli görülebilir; fakat onda bir problem yoktur. Maksat, o devenin onlarla birlikte bulunmasının yasaklanmasıdır. Bu hadiste onun satılmasına, kesilmesine veya Nebî sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’in beraberliği dışında ona binilmesine dair bir yasak yoktur. Aksine bunların tamamı ve diğer tasarruflar caizdir; sadece onunla Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’e arkadaşlık etmek engellenmiştir. Çünkü bu tasarrufların hepsi caizdi; bunlardan bir kısmı yasaklanınca, geri kalanı önceki hâli üzere kaldı. Allah en iyi bilendir.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Abu Barzah Nadlah ibn ‘Ubayd al-Aslami, may Allah be pleased with him, said: A slave-girl was on a she-camel carrying some of the people’s belongings. She saw the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, while the mountain pass had become narrow for them, and she said: “Hal! O Allah, curse it.” The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said: “A she-camel upon which there is a curse must not accompany us.” The word “hal” is with an open ha’ and a still lam; it is a word used to urge or restrain camels. Know that the meaning of this hadith may appear problematic, but there is no problem in it. What is meant is the prohibition of that she-camel accompanying them. There is no prohibition in it against selling it, slaughtering it, or riding it outside the company of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace. Rather, all of that and other forms of disposal are permissible; only its accompanying him was prohibited. Since all those forms of disposal had been permissible, some of them were prohibited while the rest remained as they had been. Allah knows best.

tr.clean: İbn Mes’ûd’dan (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Hz. Peygamber : –Kalbinde zerre kadar kibir bulunan kimse cennete giremez, buyurmuştu. Birisi: –Ey Allah’ın Resûlü, kişi, elbise ve ayakkabısının güzel olmasını sever. (Bu da kibir sayılır mı?), dedi. Resûl-i Ekrem: –Allah güzeldir, güzelliği sever. For the chief ..' and such like, Allah will put two angels in charge of him who will beat on the breast and ask him (disapproving): 'Were you like that?' ".

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Ebû Mûsâ radıyallahu anhın rivayetine göre Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: ‘Ölen hiçbir kimse yoktur ki onun ardından ağlayanlar kalkıp “Vah dağım! Vah efendim!” veya buna benzer sözler söylesin de iki melek ona görevlendirilip göğsüne vurarak “Sen böyle miydin?” demesin.’ Tirmizî rivayet etmiş ve ‘hasen hadis’ demiştir. ‘Lehz’: elin tamamıyla göğse itmek demektir.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Abu Musa, may Allah be pleased with him, narrated that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: ‘There is no deceased person who dies and whose mourners stand and say, “Alas, my mountain! Alas, my master!” or the like, except that two angels are appointed over him, striking him in the chest and saying: Were you like this?’ Al-Tirmidhi narrated it and said: It is a hasan hadith. ‘Lahz’ means pushing in the chest with the whole hand.

items.text_tr: Ebû Mâlik el-Eş’arî’den (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah şöyle buyurmuştur: Cenazeye ağıt yakan ağıtçı kadın, ölmeden evvel tövbe etmezse kıyamet günü üzerinde katrandan bir gömlek ve uyuzlu bir giysi olduğu hâlde diriltilir.
items.text_en: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If anyone dies and the mourner gets up and says: 'Alas! For the mountain among men. Alas! For the chief ..' and such like, Allah will put two angels in charge of him who will beat on the breast and ask him (disapproving): 'Were you like that?' ".

ar.clean: وعن يزيد بن شريك بن طارق قال: رأيت عليا رضي الله عنه على المنبر يخطب، فسمعته يقول: لا والله ما عندنا من كتاب نقرؤه إلا كتاب الله، وما في هذه الصحيفة، فنشرها فإذا فيها أسنان الإبل، وأشياء من الجراحات، وفيها: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "المدينة حرم ما بين عير إلى ثور، فمن أحدث فيها حدثاً، أو آوى محدثاً، فعليه لعنة الله والملائكة والناس أجمعين، لا يقبل الله منه يوم القيامة صرفاً ولا عدلاً، ذمة المسلمين واحدة، يسعى بها أدناهم، فمن أخفر مسلماً، فعليه لعنة الله والملائكة والناس أجمعين، لا يقبل الله منه يوم القيامة صرفاً ولا عدلاً، ومن ادعى إلى غير أبيه، أو انتمى إلى غير مواليه، فعليه لعنة الله والملائكة والناس أجمعين، لا يقبل الله منه يوم القيامة صرفاً ولا عدلاً" "ذِمَّةُ المُسْلِمِينَ"أيْ: عَهْدُهُمْ وأمانتُهُم."وَأخْفَرَهُ": نَقَضَ عَهْدَهُ."والصَّرفُ": التَّوْبَةُ، وَقِيلَ: الحِيلَةُ."وَالْعَدْلُ": الفِدَاءُ.

en.clean: Yazid bin Sharik bin Tariq (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I saw 'Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) giving a Khutbah (sermon) from the pulpit and I heard him saying: "By Allah, we have no book to read except Allah's Book and what is written in this scroll. He unrolled the scroll which showed a list of what sort of camels to be given as blood-money, and other legal matters relating to killing game in the sanctuary of Makkah and the expiation thereof. In it was also written: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Al-Madinah is a sanctuary from 'Air to Thaur (mountains). He who innovates in this territory new ideas in Islam, commits a sin therein, or shelters the innovators, will incur the Curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people, and Allah will accept from him neither repentance nor a ransom on the Day of Resurrection. The asylum (pledge of protection) granted by any Muslim (even of the) lowest status is to be honoured and respected by all other Muslims, and whoever betrays a Muslim in this respect (by violating the pledge) will incur the Curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people; and Allah will accept from him neither repentance nor a ransom on the Day of Resurrection. Whoever attributes his fatherhood to someone other than his (real) father, and takes someone else as his master other than his (real) master without his permission, will incur the Curse of Allah, the angels and all the people, and Allah will accept from him neither repentance nor a ransom on the Day of Resurrection.".

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: Yezîd b. Şerîk b. Târık şöyle dedi: Ali radıyallahu anh’ı minber üzerinde hutbe verirken gördüm ve şöyle dediğini işittim: “Hayır, Allah’a yemin ederim ki bizim yanımızda Allah’ın Kitabı’ndan ve şu sahîfede bulunanlardan başka okuduğumuz bir kitap yoktur.” Sonra sahîfeyi açtı; içinde develerin yaşlarına ve yaralanmalara dair bazı hükümler vardı. Orada şu da vardı: Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: “Medine, Ayr ile Sevr arasında haram bölgedir. Kim orada bir bid‘at/zulüm ortaya çıkarır veya böyle birini barındırırsa, Allah’ın, meleklerin ve bütün insanların lâneti onun üzerine olsun. Allah kıyamet günü ondan ne farz ne nafile, ne tevbe ne de fidye kabul eder. Müslümanların zimmeti birdir; onların en aşağı derecede olanı bile bu zimmeti verir. Kim bir Müslümanın ahdini bozarsa, Allah’ın, meleklerin ve bütün insanların lâneti onun üzerine olsun. Allah kıyamet günü ondan ne farz ne nafile, ne tevbe ne de fidye kabul eder. Kim kendisini babasından başkasına nispet eder veya velâ bakımından asıl sahiplerinden başkasına intisap ederse, Allah’ın, meleklerin ve bütün insanların lâneti onun üzerine olsun. Allah kıyamet günü ondan ne farz ne nafile, ne tevbe ne de fidye kabul eder.” “Müslümanların zimmeti” onların ahdi ve emânıdır. “Ahferahu” ahdini bozdu demektir. “Sarf” tevbe demektir; hile olduğu da söylenmiştir. “Adl” fidye demektir.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Yazid ibn Sharik ibn Tariq said: I saw ‘Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) on the pulpit delivering a sermon, and I heard him say: “No, by Allah, we have no book that we read except the Book of Allah and what is in this sheet.” He unfolded it, and in it were the ages of camels and matters concerning wounds. It also contained: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “Madinah is a sanctuary between ‘Ayr and Thawr. Whoever introduces an unlawful innovation or offense therein, or shelters one who does so, upon him is the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people. On the Day of Resurrection Allah will accept from him neither obligatory nor voluntary deed, neither repentance nor ransom. The covenant of the Muslims is one; the least of them may grant it. Whoever violates the covenant of a Muslim, upon him is the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people. On the Day of Resurrection Allah will accept from him neither obligatory nor voluntary deed, neither repentance nor ransom. Whoever claims affiliation to someone other than his father, or attaches himself to patrons other than his rightful patrons, upon him is the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people. On the Day of Resurrection Allah will accept from him neither obligatory nor voluntary deed, neither repentance nor ransom.” “The covenant of the Muslims” means their pledge and security. “Akhfarahu” means that he broke his covenant. “Sarf” means repentance; it has also been said to mean a stratagem. “ ‘Adl” means ransom.

items.text_ar: وعن يزيد بن شريك بن طارق قال: رأيت عليا رضي الله عنه على المنبر يخطب، فسمعته يقول: لا والله ما عندنا من كتاب نقرؤه إلا كتاب الله، وما في هذه الصحيفة، فنشرها فإذا فيها أسنان الإبل، وأشياء من الجراحات، وفيها: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "المدينة حرم ما بين عير إلى ثور، فمن أحدث فيها حدثاً، أو آوى محدثاً، فعليه لعنة الله والملائكة والناس أجمعين، لا يقبل الله منه يوم القيامة صرفاً ولا عدلاً، ذمة المسلمين واحدة، يسعى بها أدناهم، فمن أخفر مسلماً، فعليه لعنة الله والملائكة والناس أجمعين، لا يقبل الله منه يوم القيامة صرفاً ولا عدلاً، ومن ادعى إلى غير أبيه، أو انتمى إلى غير مواليه، فعليه لعنة الله والملائكة والناس أجمعين، لا يقبل الله منه يوم القيامة صرفاً ولا عدلاً" "ذِمَّةُ المُسْلِمِينَ"أيْ: عَهْدُهُمْ وأمانتُهُم."وَأخْفَرَهُ": نَقَضَ عَهْدَهُ."والصَّرفُ": التَّوْبَةُ، وَقِيلَ: الحِيلَةُ."وَالْعَدْلُ": الفِدَاءُ.
items.text_tr: Sa’d b. Ebû Vakkâs’tan (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Hz. Peygamber şöyle buyurmuştur: Kim babası olmadığını bildiği hâlde, babasından başka birine “babamdır” diye neseb iddia ederse, cennet ona haramdır.
items.text_en: Yazid bin Sharik bin Tariq (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I saw 'Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) giving a Khutbah (sermon) from the pulpit and I heard him saying: "By Allah, we have no book to read except Allah's Book and what is written in this scroll. He unrolled the scroll which showed a list of what sort of camels to be given as blood-money, and other legal matters relating to killing game in the sanctuary of Makkah and the expiation thereof. In it was also written: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Al-Madinah is a sanctuary from 'Air to Thaur (mountains). He who innovates in this territory new ideas in Islam, commits a sin therein, or shelters the innovators, will incur the Curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people, and Allah will accept from him neither repentance nor a ransom on the Day of Resurrection. The asylum (pledge of protection) granted by any Muslim (even of the) lowest status is to be honoured and respected by all other Muslims, and whoever betrays a Muslim in this respect (by violating the pledge) will incur the Curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people; and Allah will accept from him neither repentance nor a ransom on the Day of Resurrection. Whoever attributes his fatherhood to someone other than his (real) father, and takes someone else as his master other than his (real) master without his permission, will incur the Curse of Allah, the angels and all the people, and Allah will accept from him neither repentance nor a ransom on the Day of Resurrection.".

rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: It is narrated from the Mother of the Believers Umm Salamah—whose name was Hind bint Abi Umayyah Hudhayfah al-Makhzumiyyah, may Allah be pleased with her—that when the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, left his house, he would say: ‘In the name of Allah; I place my trust in Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from going astray or being led astray, from slipping or being caused to slip, from wronging or being wronged, and from acting ignorantly or being treated with ignorance.’

O şöyle dedi: ‘Sabredin; çünkü Rabbinize kavuşuncaya kadar, bir zaman gelmez ki ondan sonraki zaman ondan daha kötü olmasın.’ Bunu Peygamberiniz sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’den işittim.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Al-Zubayr ibn ‘Adi said: We came to Anas ibn Malik, may Allah be pleased with him, and complained to him of what we were suffering from al-Hajjaj. He said: ‘Be patient, for no time will come except that the time after it is worse than it, until you meet your Lord.’ I heard this from your Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him.
rawExcel.sunnah.com_arabic_full_text: السادس: عن الزبير بن عدي قال: أتينا أنس بن مالك رضي الله عنه فشكونا إليه ما نلقى من الحجاج. فقال: "اصبروا فإنه لا يأتي زمان إلا والذي بعده شر منه حتى تلقوا ربكم" سمعته من نبيكم صلى الله عليه وسلم.

rawExcel.english_full_text: Az-Zubair bin 'Adi said: We went to Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) and complained to him of suffering at the hands of Al-Hajjaj. tr.clean: Bedir Savaşı’na katılan Ebû Mes’ûd Ukbe b. Amr el-Ensârî (ra) anlatıyor: Sadaka âyeti nâzil olunca (biz de sadaka verebilmek için) hamallık yapıp sırtımızda yük taşımaya başladık. Bir gün bir adam geldi ve o kadar çok sadaka verdi ki, (bazıları) “gösteriş yapıyor” dediler. Başka biri geldi, bir sâ (miktarı hurma) verdi. (Onun için de) “Allah’ın bunun bir sâ (hurmas)ına ihtiyacı yok.” dediler. Bunun üzerine, “Sadakalar hususunda gönüllü bağışta bulunan müminlerle, güçlerinin yettiğinden başkasını bulamayanları çekiştirip onlarla alay edenler var ya…” meâlindeki âyet indi.

en.clean: Abu Mas'ud 'Uqbah bin 'Amr Al-Ansari (May Allah be pleased with him) said: When the Ayah enjoining Sadaqah (charity) was revealed,* we used to carry loads on our backs to earn something that we could give away in charity. One person presented a considerable amount for charity and the hypocrites said: "He has done it to show off." Another one gave away a few Sa' of dates and they said: "Allah does not stand in need of this person's dates". Thereupon, it was revealed:"Those who defame such of the believers who give charity (in Allah's Cause) voluntarily, and such who could not find to give charity (in Allah's Cause) except what is available to them.." (9:79).* This is the version of Al-Bukhari.

rawExcel.CPT_turkish_translation: On altıncı hadis: Ebû Mes‘ûd Ukbe b. Amr el-Ensârî el-Bedrî’den (r.a.) rivayet edildiğine göre şöyle dedi: Sadaka âyeti indiğinde biz sırtımızda yük taşıyarak çalışır, kazancımızdan sadaka verirdik. Bir adam gelip çokça sadaka verdi; bunun üzerine bazıları, “Gösteriş yapıyor” dediler. Başka bir adam da bir sâ‘ miktarı sadaka getirdi; bu defa, “Allah bunun bir sâ‘ına muhtaç değildir” dediler. Bunun üzerine, “Müminlerden gönüllü olarak sadaka verenleri ve güçlerinin yettiğinden başkasını bulamayanları ayıplayanlar...” âyeti (Tevbe 9/79) indi.
rawExcel.CPT_english_translation: Sixteenth hadith: It is narrated from Abu Mas‘ud ‘Uqbah ibn ‘Amr al-Ansari al-Badri (may Allah be pleased with him) that he said: When the verse concerning charity was revealed, we used to carry loads on our backs to earn and give charity. A man came and gave a large amount in charity, and they said, ‘He is showing off.’ Another man came and gave a sa‘, and they said, ‘Allah has no need of this man’s sa‘.’ Then the verse was revealed: “Those who criticize the willing givers among the believers concerning charities, and those who find nothing except their effort...” (al-Tawbah 9:79).

ar.sourceText: وعن سهل بن سعيد رضي الله عنه: قال رسول صلى الله عليه وسلم: " أنا وكافل اليتيم في الجنة هكذا" وأشار بالسبابة والوسطى، وفرج بينهما.

tr.clean: Yine Ebû Hüreyre’den (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah şöyle buyurmuştur: Yoksul kimse, kapı kapı dolaşıp bir iki hurma, bir iki lokma ile savuşturulan kimse değildir. Gerçek yoksul, (sadaka isteyemeyen) iffetli ve nezih kimsedir. (B4539 Buhârî, Tefsîr, (Bakara) 48; M2394 Müslim, Zekât, 102) Buhârî ve Müslim’deki bir rivayete göre “İnsanları dolaşıp bir iki lokma ve bir iki hurma ile savuşturulan, yoksul değildir. Gerçek yoksul, geçimini sağlayacak imkânı bulunmayan ve halk tarafından durumu bilinmediği için sadaka verilemeyen ve kendisi de kalkıp sadaka isteyemeyen kimsedir.” buyurmuştur.

ar.clean: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: كنت أمشى مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، وعليه برد نجرانى غليظ الحاشية، فأدركه أعرابى، فجبذه بردائه جبذة شديدة، فنظرت إلى صفحة عاتق النبى صلى الله عليه وسلم، وقد أثرت بها حاشية البرد من شدة فضحك، ثم قال: يا محمد مر لى من مال الله الذى عندك، فالتفت إليه فضحك ثم أمر له بعطاء.

tr.clean: Hz. Âişe (ra) şöyle demiştir: Resûlullah iki işten birini seçmek durumunda kalırsa, günah olmadığı sürece en kolay olanını seçerdi. Yapılacak şey günah ise ondan herkesten daha fazla uzaklaşırdı. Resûl-i Ekrem, herhangi bir şeyden dolayı kendisi için asla intikam almadı; eğer Allah’ın bir yasağı çiğnenirse işte o zaman Allah için müeyyide uygulardı.
